CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mary B. Andersen, her daughter Martha, and Max Andersen.

**Sighting:** On an early evening in October, Mary B. Andersen was in her home when her daughter Martha asked if a plane's light would flash. Upon looking, they observed a revolving bluish-white light hovering over trees at the far end of their field.

**Object:** A revolving bluish-white light that moved toward the right over the trees, alternating between moving fast and slowing to a standstill.

**Aftermath:** The witnesses observed the light for approximately half an hour before it disappeared to the North West of the field. A statement was taken by Cst. J. A. Brown on 79DEC17.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Mary B. Andersen、她的女儿 Martha 以及 Max Andersen。

**目击：** 10 月的一个傍晚，Mary B. Andersen 在家中时，她的女儿 Martha 询问飞机的灯光是否会闪烁。她查看后，观察到一个旋转的蓝白色光点悬停在田地尽头的树木上方。

**物体：** 一个旋转的蓝白色光点，在树木上方往右移动，时而快速移动，时而减速至静止。

**后续：** 目击者观察该光点约半小时，随后它向田地的西北方向消失。Cst. J. A. Brown 于 79 年 12 月 17 日记录了证词。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Wally Fenc and Rick Coley.

**Sighting:** On October 5, 1979, at approximately 1:30 A.M., Wally Fenc was working the night shift at a gas plant twelve miles north of Rocky Mountain House. He observed an object moving west to east, parallel to the earth. He alerted his assistant, Rick Coley, and they watched the object for approximately 2-3 minutes until it disappeared.

**Object:** The object appeared very large, with witnesses comparing its size to a football field. It featured five or six bright lights and appeared to obscure the moon as it passed. As it moved behind plant towers, the lights turned a fiery orange color with light streams of the same color. Witnesses observed balls of light that seemed to grow and explode. The object appeared to drop slowly behind the hills.

**Aftermath:** No noise was heard from the object, though the plant process may have drowned out any sound. Wally Fenc contacted the R.C.M.P. to report the incident, suggesting it might have been a large airliner.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Wally Fenc 和 Rick Coley。

**目击：** 1979年10月5日凌晨1点30分左右，Wally Fenc 在落基山庄（Rocky Mountain House）以北12英里的天然气厂值夜班。他观察到一个物体从西向东移动，与地面平行。他叫来了助手 Rick Coley，两人观察了该物体约2-3分钟，直到它消失。

**物体：** 该物体看起来非常巨大，目击者将其比作一个足球场的大小。它有五到六个明亮的灯光，经过时似乎遮住了月亮。当它移动到工厂塔楼后面时，灯光变成了火橙色，并伴有同色的光流。目击者观察到光球似乎在变大并爆炸。该物体似乎缓慢地落在了山丘后面。

**后续：** 目击者没有听到来自物体的任何声音，尽管工厂的运作过程可能掩盖了噪音。Wally Fenc 联系了加拿大皇家骑警（R.C.M.P.）报告了这一事件，并表示它可能是一架大型客机。
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Boniface Sassie, Edward Diamond, and Pauline Diamond.

**Sighting:** On June 13, 1978, at 2000 hours Mountain Standard Time, an unidentified flying object was observed in the sky over Fort Liard, NWT. The object was heading southeast at an estimated height of two miles. The sighting lasted for about two seconds before the object exploded immediately above Fort Liard.

**Object:** The object was described as having a bright blue and red burning spherical nose with a long bright white body leading to a 10-foot white tail. There was only one object. The explosion resulted in a spherical cloud, and no debris was reported. Thunder was heard one second after the explosion. The trajectory was at a slight downward angle in comparison to the horizon.

**Aftermath:** The report was transmitted to the National Research Council in Ottawa. The document includes a stamp noting it was "Identified as possible meteor."
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Boniface Sassie, Edward Diamond, Pauline Diamond。

**目击：** 1978年6月13日2000时（山区标准时间），在西北地区Fort Liard上空观测到一个不明飞行物。该物体向东南方向飞行，估计高度为两英里。目击持续了约两秒钟，随后该物体在Fort Liard正上方发生爆炸。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为具有明亮的蓝色和红色燃烧球形鼻部，带有长而明亮的白色主体，并拖着一条10英尺长的白色尾迹。仅有一个物体。爆炸产生了一个球形云团，未报告有碎片。爆炸后一秒钟听到了雷声。其轨迹相对于地平线呈轻微向下倾斜的角度。

**后续：** 该报告被发送至渥太华的国家研究委员会。文件上盖有“被认定为可能是流星”的印章。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Cst. L.M. Leyh of the Hope Highway Patrol.

**Sighting:** On 79-01-31 at 17:20 hours, while off shift in the Hope Detachment area, the witness observed a fireball. The location of the witness was on 3rd Avenue in front of the Overwaitea Grocery Store in Hope, B.C. The weather was clear just before dusk.

**Object:** The object was described as white to yellow in color with a white trail. It was located in the northern sky to the east of Dog Mountain and appeared to be the size of a large star. The duration of the sighting was approximately 2 seconds, and no sound was emitted.

**Aftermath:** There were no other occurrences after the burnup of the fireball in the sky. The report is stamped "IDENTIFIED AS A METEOR."
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 希望公路巡逻队警员 L.M. Leyh。

**目击：** 79年1月31日17时20分，该警员在下班期间于不列颠哥伦比亚省希望镇的 Overwaitea 杂货店门前的第三大道上目击了一个火球。当时天气晴朗，正值黄昏前。

**物体：** 该物体呈白色至黄色，带有白色尾迹。它位于北部天空，狗山以东，大小如同一颗大星。目击持续时间约为2秒，未发出任何声音。

**后续：** 火球在天空中燃尽后未再发生其他现象。该报告盖有“IDENTIFIED AS A METEOR”（确认为流星）的印章。

Warren in St. Laurent, Quebec describes seeing a circular UFO while seated at the kitchen table and looking out the kitchen window. The object was said to move from right to left across the witness’s line of vision, with a row of bright white circular openings or lights around its edge. The letter is dated 25 Jan 1980, with a file/date stamp of 1980-01-17, while the sighting itself is recalled as having occurred on a weekend in late Nov. or early Dec. 1978.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh: 这是魁北克省圣洛朗的 M. A. Warren 亲笔报告：他坐在厨房餐桌旁向外看时，看见一个圆形不明飞行物从视野右侧向左侧移动，边缘有一排明亮的白色圆孔或灯光。信件日期为 1980 年 1 月 25 日，页上另有 1980-01-17 的档案/日期戳；但目击时间回忆为 1978 年 11 月末或 12 月初的某个周末。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Storrs McCall.

**Sighting:** On January 2, 1980, at 6:38 p.m., a bright white object was observed in the sky north of Pointe à Pitre, Guadeloupe.

**Object:** The object was moving quickly from east to west, parallel to the earth's surface, and was not falling. A piece broke off, remained behind, burned out, and then the entire object was extinguished.

**Aftermath:** The report was sent to the Atmospheric & Satellite Service of the National Research Council. The document is stamped 'IDENTIFIED AS POSSIBLE METEOR'.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Storrs McCall。

**目击：** 1980年1月2日下午6:38，在瓜德罗普岛皮特尔角城以北的天空中观察到一个明亮的白色物体。

**物体：** 该物体快速地从东向西移动，与地表平行，并非坠落。物体有一部分脱落，留在原地并烧毁，随后整个物体熄灭。

**后续：** 该报告被发送至加拿大国家研究委员会的大气与卫星服务部门。文件上盖有“IDENTIFIED AS POSSIBLE METEOR”（确认为可能的流星）的印章。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Cecil Paul and Mrs. Paul, residing at Bayview Estates, RR2 Trenton, Ontario.

**Sighting:** The sighting occurred on January 27, 1980, at 270850Z. The location was identified as Frankford, Ontario (New Bridge).

**Object:** The object was described as a steady, bright yellow light. It exhibited both horizontal and vertical movement before dropping out of sight behind hills. The witness noted that it did not appear to be an aircraft.

**Aftermath:** The duration of the sighting was 25 minutes. The report was transmitted from CFB Ops Trenton to the National Research Council (NRC) for the Radio and Electrical Engineering Division.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Cecil Paul 和 Mrs. Paul，居住于安大略省特伦顿 RR2 Bayview Estates。

**目击：** 目击事件发生于1980年1月27日，时间为 270850Z。地点位于安大略省弗兰克福德（新桥）。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为一个稳定、明亮的黄色光点。它表现出水平和垂直方向的移动，随后消失在山后。目击者指出它看起来不像飞机。

**后续：** 目击持续时间为25分钟。该报告由特伦顿空军基地行动中心（CFB Ops Trenton）发送至加拿大国家研究委员会（NRC）无线电与电气工程部门。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** The nine-year-old son of Mr. Jim Cross, Mrs. Baker, and five people at the residence of Mr. Doug Green.

**Sighting:** On January 28, 1980, at 0115Z, under clear skies, a nine-year-old boy observed a purplish glowing object. The object appeared to land in the woods across the road behind the Green residence.

**Object:** A purplish glowing object.

**Aftermath:** The sighting lasted for two or three minutes. The information was passed to the Dartmouth Police Department.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 吉姆·克罗斯先生的九岁儿子、贝克夫人，以及道格·格林先生住所的五人。

**目击：** 1980年1月28日0115Z，在晴朗的天空下，一名九岁男孩观察到一个紫色的发光物体。该物体似乎降落在格林住所后方马路对面的树林里。

**物体：** 一个紫色的发光物体。

**后续：** 目击持续了两到三分钟。此信息已转达给达特茅斯警察局。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Zeke Trelosnak and Robert Emtey, both from Eldorado.

**Sighting:** The report describes a sighting on January 30, 1980, in very clear conditions. The witnesses observed the object for at least one half hour, though they could not provide an exact time.

**Object:** The object was described as a vivid white light with alternate red and green lights. The witness stated it was not an aircraft because they had not heard it pass.

**Aftermath:** The witnesses lost sight of the object behind a ridge to the west.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Zeke Trelosnak 和 Robert Emtey，两人均来自 Eldorado。

**目击：** 报告描述了 1980 年 1 月 30 日在天气非常晴朗的情况下发生的一次目击事件。目击者观察该物体至少半小时，但无法提供确切时间。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为带有交替红绿灯的明亮白光。目击者称其并非飞机，因为他们没有听到它经过的声音。

**后续：** 目击者在西侧的山脊后失去了对该物体的视线。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. Ethel Holderbein, Tom and Terry Wilson.

**Sighting:** Mrs. Holderbein reported observing an object flying west along Highway #1 towards Herbert. She stated the object displayed yellow, red, green, and blue flashing lights. She also noted that Tom and Terry Wilson, who live on a farm three miles east of Morse, had observed a similar object between 20:00 and 21:00 hours every night since the previous Thursday.

**Object:** An object displaying yellow, red, green, and blue flashing lights.

**Aftermath:** The report was recorded for information purposes by Cpl. Finley of the Morse Detachment. A message regarding the incident was sent to the National Research Council in Ottawa on January 24, 1950.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Ethel Holderbein 夫人，Tom Wilson 和 Terry Wilson。

**目击：** Holderbein 夫人报告称观察到一个物体沿 1 号公路向 Herbert 方向飞行。她指出该物体显示出黄色、红色、绿色和蓝色的闪烁灯光。她还提到住在 Morse 以东三英里处农场的 Tom 和 Terry Wilson 自上周四以来，每晚在 20:00 到 21:00 之间都观察到了类似的物体。

**物体：** 一个显示黄色、红色、绿色和蓝色闪烁灯光的物体。

**后续：** 该报告由 Morse 分队的 Finley 下士记录以供参考。关于此事件的消息已于 1950 年 1 月 24 日发送至渥太华的国家研究委员会。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Ethel Holderbein, residing in Morse, and Tom and Terry Wilson, residing on a farm 3 miles east of Morse, Saskatchewan.

**Sighting:** The witnesses reported sightings of a bright colored object. The reporting officer noted that the witnesses were unable to provide an accurate altitude for the object's movement.

**Object:** A bright colored object.

**Aftermath:** The investigating officer, Cpl. R.G. Finley, interviewed the witnesses and deemed them to be reliable. Mrs. Holderbein contacted an observatory in Regina, which suggested the object may have been the planet Venus. A copy of the report was forwarded to the National Research Council, Planetary Science Section, in Ottawa for information purposes.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 居住在莫尔斯的埃塞尔·霍尔德拜恩（Ethel Holderbein），以及居住在萨斯喀彻温省莫尔斯以东3英里处农场的汤姆·威尔逊（Tom Wilson）和特里·威尔逊（Terry Wilson）。

**目击：** 目击者报告称看到了一个明亮的彩色物体。调查警官指出，目击者无法提供该物体运动的准确高度。

**物体：** 一个明亮的彩色物体。

**后续：** 调查警官R.G.芬利（R.G. Finley）对目击者进行了访谈，并认为他们是可靠的。霍尔德拜恩夫人联系了里贾纳的一家天文台，该天文台建议所见物体可能是金星。这份报告的副本已被转发至位于渥太华的加拿大国家研究委员会行星科学部门，以供参考。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Elwood Feindl, Lavine Feindl, Max Meisner, and Glenda Meisner.

**Sighting:** The witnesses reported observing a U.F.O. for approximately one hour. The object was first sighted at Union Square and followed by the witnesses to New Canada. The witnesses then drove north on Sarty Road, where they observed the object again.

**Object:** The object was described as triangular in shape. In daylight, it appeared to be made of highly polished metal, while in the dark, it appeared as a huge white light. It was estimated to be nearly as big as the moon, featuring red and green rays. Before dark, a black streak coming to a point was observed running beside the object. The U.F.O. was estimated to be approximately 1000 to 2000 feet above the witness's house and vehicle.

**Aftermath:** The report was filed by the Bridgewater Detachment of the RCMP.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Elwood Feindl, Lavine Feindl, Max Meisner 和 Glenda Meisner。

**目击：** 目击者报告称观察到一个不明飞行物约一小时。该物体最初在 Union Square 被发现，随后被目击者追踪至 New Canada。目击者随后驱车向北行驶至 Sarty Road，再次观察到了该物体。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为三角形。在日光下，它看起来像是由高度抛光的金属制成；在黑暗中，它表现为一个巨大的白光。据估计，它的大小接近月球，并带有红色和绿色的光束。在天黑之前，观察到物体旁边有一条尖状的黑色条纹。据估计，该不明飞行物位于目击者房屋和车辆上方约 1000 到 2000 英尺处。

**后续：** 该报告由加拿大皇家骑警 (RCMP) Bridgewater 分队存档。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Donna Willitt and three friends.

**Sighting:** On February 3, 1980, the witnesses were in a pick-up truck driving on a secondary road seven miles north of Wildewood, Alberta. They observed an object that appeared to float at the level of a telephone pole above their vehicle.

**Object:** The object was oval-shaped, silver on top with a black underside. It featured a steady blue light on the right side and a steady red light on the left side. No noise was heard. The object traveled slowly over the truck in a south-east direction. When the truck turned to follow it, a second object with similar lights appeared, flying beneath the first from west to east before moving away in a north-west direction. A flashing white light then appeared in the middle of the first object.

**Aftermath:** The duration of the sighting was approximately 20 minutes. No further details are provided.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Donna Willitt 和三位朋友。

**目击：** 1980年2月3日，见证者们乘坐一辆皮卡车行驶在阿尔伯塔省 Wildewood 以北七英里的二级公路上。他们观察到一个物体，看起来悬浮在车辆上方电线杆的高度。

**物体：** 该物体呈椭圆形，顶部为银色，底部为黑色。右侧有一盏稳定的蓝灯，左侧有一盏稳定的红灯。未听到任何声音。该物体缓慢地向东南方向飞过卡车。当卡车转向跟随它时，出现了第二个带有类似灯光的物体，从西向东在第一个物体下方飞行，随后向西北方向飞离。此时，第一个物体的中间出现了一盏闪烁的白灯。

**后续：** 目击持续时间约为20分钟。未提供更多细节。
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** K. Dash and three other occupants in a vehicle.

**Sighting:** On February 4, 1980, at 0307Z, witnesses in a vehicle west of the city observed objects at a low altitude over a field. The sighting lasted approximately 15 minutes, and no sound was heard.

**Object:** The first object was round and flat, not thick in the center, with red lights on one side and blue lights on the opposite side. A second object, which had a steady bright white light, followed the first as if chasing it. Both objects moved in a random fashion in a general direction from west to south.

**Aftermath:** The occupants exited their vehicle to view the objects as they moved towards and over the vehicle.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** K. Dash 以及车内的另外三名乘客。

**目击：** 1980年2月4日 0307Z，位于城市西部的目击者观察到田野上空有低空飞行的物体。目击持续了约15分钟，期间未听到任何声音。

**后续：** 驾驶员摇下了车窗，但没有停车。在遭遇期间，汽车表现异常，运行不稳。大约五分钟后，物体飞离。

**Witnesses:** Mr. Earl Sutley of Moonbeam, Ontario, and Mr. Antoni Brook of 17 Lenard St, Moonbeam, Ontario.

**Sighting:** Two separate sightings occurred on February 8, 1980. The first was at 0139Z by Mr. Earl Sutley. The second was at 0400Z by Mr. Antoni Brook. Both observers were located in Moonbeam, Ontario.

**Witnesses:** Mr. Eric Fry, Mr. Art Coker, Mrs. Rose Coker, Mr. Gordon Williams, Mrs. Dolly Williams, and Mr. Glen Burton.

**Sighting:** The page reports sightings occurring on three separate nights in February 1980. The object was observed at one o'clock high and descended to approximately five o'clock. **Object:** The object is described as saucer-shaped and white. On the first and third nights, the object turned on its side, displaying red and blue lights, and emitted a single bright white beam.

**Aftermath:** On the first night, Mr. Fry contacted radio station CFEK Huntsville and spoke with Ray Garrot. The station announced the sighting on the radio, which resulted in a call from the Parry Sound area confirming the sighting.

**物体：** 该物体被描述为碟形且呈白色。在第一晚和第三晚，物体侧转并显示出红色和蓝色的灯光，同时发出一道明亮的白光束。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. Susan Smith, who was alone in her car.

**Sighting:** On February 9, 1980, at approximately 0020Z, under clear skies, a brilliant white light appeared high overhead. The object was moving north-bound and lasted for approximately ten seconds from the time it was first seen until the glow from the flash faded. The light exploded into a blue and orange flash.

**Object:** Described as a brilliant white light that produced one burst. No sound was heard by the observer in the car.

**Aftermath:** The incident was reported to the Rescue Co-ordination Centre in Trenton. Similar sightings were reported by observers at Harcourt (4505N 07817W), who also reported a white light that appeared to explode. Other reports were received from the Oshawa area from aircraft and ground observers. The document is marked "IDENTIFIED AS A METEOR".
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:

**物体：** 被描述为一道明亮的白光，产生了一次爆发。车内的观察者没有听到任何声音。

**后续：** 该事件被报告给特伦顿的救援协调中心。哈考特（4505N 07817W）的观察者也报告了类似的目击事件，他们同样报告称看到一道白光并发生了爆炸。奥沙瓦地区的飞机和地面观察员也报告了相关情况。该文件被标记为“确认为流星”。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Keith Blakeney Jr., a youth born on 26 Sep 65.

**Sighting:** On 80-02-08 at 2050 hours AST, the witness was walking along Highway #1 (TCH) in a westerly direction, one quarter mile east of his residence. The sky was clear with no clouds and a dark moon.

**Object:** The witness observed one bright bluish-green oval-shaped object with a cloud-reflecting effect surrounding it. It was approximately two feet in diameter and moved very fast from south to north directly overhead. The object appeared to disappear behind trees on the north side of the highway. There was no evidence of noise, and the duration of the observation was in seconds.

**Aftermath:** The witness reported the event to the Fredericton RCMP Detachment. The observer was described as a sensible youth who would not make up stories to get attention; he arrived home frightened and told his parents what he saw. A telex was sent to the National Research Council. Air Traffic Control at Fredericton Airport was contacted and reported no unusual occurrences that night. The report includes a stamp stating "IDENTIFIED AS POSSIBLE METEOR."
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Keith Blakeney Jr.，一位出生于1965年9月26日的青少年。

**目击：** 1980年2月8日20时50分（大西洋标准时间），目击者正沿着1号公路（TCH）向西行走，地点位于其住所东侧四分之一英里处。当时天空晴朗，无云，月色昏暗。

**物体：** 目击者观察到一个明亮的蓝绿色椭圆形物体，周围有云层反射效果。该物体直径约两英尺，以极快的速度从南向北直接从头顶飞过。物体似乎消失在公路北侧的树木后方。过程中没有声音，观察持续时间为几秒钟。

**后续：** 目击者向弗雷德里克顿（Fredericton）皇家骑警分队报告了此事。报告称该目击者是一个理智的年轻人，不会为了博取关注而编造故事；他回到家时感到害怕，并告诉了父母所见的情况。一份电传已发送至加拿大国家研究委员会。弗雷德里克顿机场的空中交通管制部门也受到了联系，但他们表示当晚未记录到任何异常情况。报告上盖有“被认定为可能是流星”（IDENTIFIED AS POSSIBLE METEOR）的印章。

**Witnesses:** Miss Peggy Glazer, Lori Glazer, and Margo McLaren.

**Sighting:** On February 10, 1980, the witnesses traveled by car from 49th Street and 40th Avenue NW, Calgary, Alberta, to Highway 1A near Cochrane, Alberta. The object was observed to be brighter than all other objects in the sky.

**Object:** The object displayed a yellowish-orange glow. It had a triangular shape when stationary, but its form was not definite when moving. It was estimated to be at an altitude of 500-1000 feet in the city and 100-200 feet in the country. No sounds were reported.

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Peggy Glazer 小姐、Lori Glazer 和 Margo McLaren。

**目击：** 1980 年 2 月 10 日，见证者乘车从艾伯塔省卡尔加里的第 49 街和第 40 大道前往艾伯塔省科克伦附近的 1A 高速公路。观察到的物体比天空中所有其他物体都要亮。

**物体：** 该物体呈现黄橙色光芒。静止时呈三角形，移动时形状不确定。据估计，在城市上空高度约为 500-1000 英尺，在乡村上空约为 100-200 英尺。未报告有任何声音。

**后续：** 该物体似乎降落在 1A 高速公路和科克伦地区。事件持续时间约为 2 小时。每当见证者移动时，UFO 就会跟随，当他们停车时，它也会停止。见证者下车查看是否为反射光，但并非如此。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. G. Loggie and his wife.

**Sighting:** On February 12, 1980, between 1155Z and 1200Z, a bright light was observed hovering in the air approximately six miles or more south of Lower Newcastle, New Brunswick. The sky was cloudy at the time. The object was observed between CFB Chatham and 21 Radar Sqn.

**Object:** The object appeared to be about 25 or more feet in length and was described as very bright. It had no normal markings or lights of a normal aircraft. There was only one object present.

**Aftermath:** The object was visible for five minutes, after which it went straight up into the cloud.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** G. Loggie 先生及其妻子。

**目击：** 1980年2月12日，在 1155Z 至 1200Z 之间，在新不伦瑞克省下纽卡斯尔以南约六英里或更远的地方，观察到一个明亮的光体悬浮在空中。当时天空多云。该物体位于查塔姆加拿大空军基地（CFB Chatham）和第21雷达中队之间。

**物体：** 该物体长度约为25英尺或以上，被描述为非常明亮。它没有正常飞机的标记或灯光。现场只有一个物体。

**后续：** 该物体可见时间为五分钟，随后径直向上进入云层。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** M. Jean Paul Deveau.

**Sighting:** The observer reported seeing an object near the Academy, northwest of the Academy over the Grindstone area in the Magdalen Islands.

**Object:** The object was described as red and violet in color, saucer-shaped, and positioned at an altitude of 10,000 feet.

**Aftermath:** The observation lasted for two or three times over the last two nights. The report was filed through M. JP Desauliers at the Grindstone Coast Guard radio.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** M. Jean Paul Deveau。

**目击：** 观察者报告称在马格达伦群岛（Magdalen Islands）的学院附近，即学院西北方格林德斯通（Grindstone）区域上空看到了一个物体。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为红色和紫色，呈碟状，高度位于10,000英尺。

**后续：** 观察持续了过去两个晚上的两到三次。该报告通过格林德斯通海岸警卫队电台的 M. JP Desauliers 提交。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Larcel Meumier of 2012 20th Ave, Lavel West, PQ.

**Sighting:** The report describes a round light, three times as bright as a star, observed moving from north to south. The object was noted to have a sparkling trail.

**Object:** A round light with a sparkling trail.

**Aftermath:** The incident was reported to the headquarters by Montreal AMIS. The document includes a stamp indicating the object was identified as a possible meteor.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 位于魁北克省拉瓦尔西区20大道2012号的Larcel Meumier先生。

**目击：** 报告描述了一个圆形的亮光，亮度是恒星的三倍，被观察到从北向南移动。该物体被注意到带有一条闪烁的尾迹。

**物体：** 一个带有闪烁尾迹的圆形亮光。

**后续：** 该事件由蒙特利尔AMIS报告给总部。文件上盖有印章，表明该物体被认定为可能的流星。

**Sighting:** The report describes a sighting that occurred near the Moncton Airport, northeast of the city.

**Object:** The object was described as a bright white light with a red tinge that appeared high and stationary.

**Aftermath:** The report was received from the Moncton ATC shift supervisor.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Doug Carson 先生及其妻子。

**目击：** 报告描述了一起发生在蒙克顿机场附近，城市东北方向的目击事件。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为一束带有红色色调的明亮白光，出现在高空且处于静止状态。

**后续：** 该报告由蒙克顿空中交通管制（ATC）轮班主管提交。

**Witnesses:** The report was received by the RCMP, specifically Constable St Pierre in Moncton.

**Sighting:** On February 15, 1980, at 0500Z, a sighting was reported in the West Nisko Island area.

**Object:** The object was described as a red light moving up and down approximately 200 feet.

**Aftermath:** The report was relayed from the RCMP to C-5 DMCC, then to 22RCC. It was also sent to SPADATS NCOC and the Herzberg Institute of Astrophysics.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:

**目击：** 1980年2月15日0500Z，在西尼斯克岛（West Nisko Island）地区有目击报告。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为一盏红灯，上下移动约200英尺。

**后续：** 该报告由加拿大皇家骑警转达给C-5 DMCC，随后转至22RCC。报告同时被发送至SPADATS NCOC和赫茨伯格天体物理研究所（Herzberg Institute of Astrophysics）。

**Witnesses:** Mrs. Jenny Raymond of 1301 Hooke Rd, Edmonton, Alberta.

**Sighting:** The event occurred on 150250Z Feb 80. The witness reported seeing hundreds of bright, flashing red lights directly overhead.

**Object:** The object was described as hundreds of bright, flashing red lights.

**Aftermath:** The lights did not move and went out suddenly. The duration of the sighting was 10 seconds.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 位于阿尔伯塔省埃德蒙顿市 Hooke 路 1301 号的 Jenny Raymond 女士。

**目击：** 事件发生在 1980 年 2 月 15 日 0250Z。目击者报告称在头顶正上方看到了数百个明亮的闪烁红灯。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为数百个明亮的闪烁红灯。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Residents of Shippegan, New Brunswick.

**Sighting:** On February 15, 1980, at 0350Z, a light was sighted over West Miscou Island and Pigeon Hill. The light was observed from Shippegan, NB.

**Object:** A big red light was reported floating up and down approximately 200 feet above the ground.

**Aftermath:** The information was called in by Moncton RCMP (Constable St. Pierre). The duration of the sighting is unknown, and there were no other known observers.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 新不伦瑞克省希佩根（Shippegan）的居民。

**目击：** 1980年2月15日0350Z，在西米斯库岛（West Miscou Island）和鸽子山（Pigeon Hill）上空发现一道光。该光是从希佩根观测到的。

**物体：** 据报告，一个巨大的红光在离地面约200英尺处上下浮动。

**后续：** 该信息由蒙克顿皇家骑警（Moncton RCMP，圣皮埃尔警官）报告。目击持续时间未知，没有其他已知的观察者。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Laurent Sivret, Jean Sivret, Ethienne Ward, Simon Sivret, and Claudette Sivret, all located at Miscou Centre.

**Sighting:** On February 14, 1980, at 23:30 hours, the witnesses observed an object while in a house in the centre of Miscou Centre. The sky was reported as hazy.

**Object:** The object was described as perfectly round and approximately 3 feet in diameter. It remained stationary above the tree line, about 1 to 1.5 miles west of the centre of the island. The object glowed and changed colors three times, cycling through bright red, orange, and green, before returning to red. It moved up and down twice before descending and disappearing from view. The duration of the sighting was between two and five minutes.

**Aftermath:** A check was conducted with the St. Margarets Radar Base (Air Force), which yielded negative results.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Laurent Sivret, Jean Sivret, Ethienne Ward, Simon Sivret 和 Claudette Sivret，均位于 Miscou Centre。

**目击：** 1980年2月14日23:30，目击者在 Miscou Centre 的一所房子里观察到了一个物体。当时天空有雾。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为完美的圆形，直径约3英尺。它停留在树线上方，位于岛中心以西约1至1.5英里处。该物体发光并变换了三次颜色，在亮红色、橙色和绿色之间循环，最后变回红色。它上下移动了两次，然后下降并消失。目击持续时间为两到五分钟。

**后续：** 经与圣玛格丽特雷达站（空军）核实，结果为阴性。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Gilles Brien (Hydro Quebec, Poste Montagnais), Mr. Gilbert Duguay, and Mr. Roch Champagne.

**Sighting:** The event occurred on February 17, 1980, at 0110Z. The weather conditions were reported as cloudy.

**Object:** The object was described as being of a reddish color. It was observed moving very slowly at an altitude just above the horizon at a distance of less than a mile.

**Aftermath:** The duration of the sighting was 6 minutes. No other information was reported.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Gilles Brien 先生（魁北克水电局，Poste Montagnais），Gilbert Duguay 先生，以及 Roch Champagne 先生。

**目击：** 事件发生于 1980 年 2 月 17 日 0110Z。当时天气状况为多云。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为红色。据观察，它移动非常缓慢，高度刚好在地平线以上，距离不到一英里。

**后续：** 目击持续时间为 6 分钟。未报告其他信息。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Jean-Claude St-Opel.

**Sighting:** On February 20, 1980, the witness was driving his truck north on Route 175. He observed a yellow-colored object that appeared to emerge from a field and rise above the trees. The object moved north along Route 175 at a speed of approximately 40 km/h, maintaining a distance of about 15 feet in front of his truck. The object then accelerated and moved toward the center of the road, stopping near a high-voltage power line.

**Object:** The object was described as yellow, approximately 5 feet in diameter, with a dark contour. It did not emit light or brilliance. When it hovered over the power line, it appeared to oscillate and emit sparks, which the witness associated with electricity.

**Aftermath:** The witness exited his truck and moved into a depression in the road. He later spoke with a Corporal Martel, who noted that the witness did not initially report the incident due to fear of ridicule. The witness expressed a desire for authorities to investigate the site to prove the intensity of the event.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Jean-Claude St-Opel。

**目击：** 1980年2月20日，目击者正驾驶卡车沿175号公路向北行驶。他观察到一个黄色的物体，似乎从田野中出现并升至树木上方。该物体以约40公里/小时的速度沿175号公路向北移动，保持在卡车前方约15英尺的距离。随后，该物体加速并移向道路中心，停在一条高压电线附近。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为黄色，直径约5英尺，带有深色轮廓。它不发光，也没有光泽。当它悬停在高压线上方时，似乎在摆动并发出火花，目击者将其与电力联系起来。

**后续：** 目击者下车并移动到路边的一个洼地。他后来与Martel下士交谈，后者指出目击者最初因害怕被嘲笑而没有报告该事件。目击者表示希望当局调查现场，以证明事件的强度。
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** M. Riopel, Cpl. Martel, and Cpl. Pilon Andre.

**Sighting:** On February 15, 1967, M. Riopel reported observing an object moving north along the road at approximately 150 feet. The object traveled about 7 miles before accelerating north. It stopped near a high-voltage power line, appearing as a dark-colored sphere about 3 feet in diameter. It hovered near the power line before moving into a depression in the road. Later, Cpl. Pilon Andre reported seeing a white-colored object moving from north to south, passing between two mountains northwest of Mont-Apica. The duration of this sighting was three minutes.

**Object:** A dark-colored sphere (Riopel) and a white-colored object (Pilon Andre).

**Aftermath:** Cpl. Martel interviewed M. Riopel and noted that Riopel did not want to be considered a crank. Riopel expressed willingness to cooperate with military authorities to prove his sincerity. It was noted that other individuals had reported similar sightings near the Mont-Apica station that were never officially recorded.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** M. Riopel, Cpl. Martel, Cpl. Pilon Andre。

**目击：** 1967年2月15日，M. Riopel报告称观察到一个物体沿公路向北移动，高度约150英尺。该物体行进了约7英里后向北加速。它停在一条高压电线附近，看起来是一个直径约3英尺的深色球体。它在高压电线附近盘旋，随后进入了路上的一个凹陷处。后来，Cpl. Pilon Andre报告称看到一个白色物体从北向南移动，穿过了Mont-Apica西北部的两座山之间。此次目击持续了三分钟。

**物体：** 一个深色球体（Riopel所见）和一个白色物体（Pilon Andre所见）。

**后续：** Cpl. Martel采访了M. Riopel，并指出Riopel不希望被视为怪人。Riopel表示愿意配合军事当局以证明其诚意。报告提到，其他人也曾报告过在Mont-Apica站附近有类似的目击事件，但从未被正式记录。
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** M. Riopel, Cplc Martel, Sgt Leclerc Alain, Sgt Perron Andre.

**Sighting:** M. Riopel reported a sphere traveling north on Route 170. The object moved at a speed of approximately 10 mph, hovering about 15 feet in front of his truck at a distance of 7 feet. It then accelerated, moved to the center of the road, and stopped above high-voltage power lines. Riopel described the object as being 10 feet in diameter with a dull yellow color, emitting no light or brilliance. He observed a propeller-like movement before it disappeared into a depression in the road. The duration was 18 minutes.

**Object:** A dull yellow sphere, approximately 10 feet in diameter, showing no light or brilliance.

**Aftermath:** Cplc Martel interviewed Riopel on March 4, 1965. Martel noted that Riopel appeared to be a sober, composed, and sincere man who was willing to undergo a lie detector test. Additionally, Sgt Leclerc Alain and Sgt Perron Andre reported seeing white circular objects moving from top to bottom and left to right near the mountains northwest of Mont-Apica. These sightings occurred on multiple occasions.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** M. Riopel, Cplc Martel, Sgt Leclerc Alain, Sgt Perron Andre。

**目击：** M. Riopel 报告称在 170 号公路上看到一个球体向北移动。该物体以约 10 英里/小时的速度移动，悬停在他卡车前方约 15 英尺处，距离约 7 英尺。随后它加速移动到道路中央，并停在高压电线上方。Riopel 描述该物体直径约 10 英尺，呈暗黄色，不发光也不闪烁。他观察到类似螺旋桨的运动，随后物体消失在路边的一个洼地中。目击持续了 18 分钟。

**物体：** 一个直径约 10 英尺的暗黄色球体，不发光，无光泽。

**后续：** Cplc Martel 于 1965 年 3 月 4 日采访了 Riopel。Martel 指出 Riopel 看起来是一个清醒、镇定且真诚的人，并表示愿意接受测谎仪测试。此外，Sgt Leclerc Alain 和 Sgt Perron Andre 报告称在 Mont-Apica 西北部的山脉附近看到白色圆形物体从上到下、从左到右移动。这些目击事件发生了多次。
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mark Topliff and David Martin.

**Sighting:** On March 8, 1980, at 21:15 PST, a sighting occurred in Rossland, BC, near the base of Red Mountain Ski Hill. The weather was clear.

**Object:** A large red glowing object with a short glowing tail was observed. The object moved fairly slowly for approximately 3 to 4 seconds.

**Aftermath:** The object was noted to emit a shower of sparks before disappearing. The incident was reported via Nelson Telecom to the Rossland detachment. The document is stamped "IDENTIFIED AS POSSIBLE METEOR".
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Mark Topliff 和 David Martin。

**目击：** 1980年3月8日21:15（太平洋标准时间），在不列颠哥伦比亚省罗斯兰（Rossland）的红山滑雪场（Red Mountain Ski Hill）基地附近发生了一起目击事件。当时天气晴朗。

**物体：** 观察到一个带有短发光尾巴的大型红色发光物体。该物体移动相当缓慢，持续时间约为3到4秒。

**后续：** 据记录，该物体在消失前喷射出火花。此事件通过尼尔森电信（Nelson Telecom）报告给罗斯兰分遣队。该文件上盖有“IDENTIFIED AS POSSIBLE METEOR”（确认为可能的流星）的印章。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Joe Mihalicz and his family.

**Sighting:** The event occurred on March 12, 1980, at 2100Z. The weather was reported as clear.

**Object:** The object was described as a single stationary light that was red, blue, and white. It was observed flashing and moving up and down, at times dipping below the horizon.

**Aftermath:** The duration of the sighting was one and one-half hours. No other information was reported.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Joe Mihalicz 及其家人。

**目击：** 事件发生于1980年3月12日2100Z。天气状况报告为晴朗。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为一个静止的红、蓝、白三色光点。观察到它在闪烁并上下移动，有时会沉入地平线以下。

**后续：** 目击持续时间为一个半小时。未报告其他信息。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Robert Baillard.

**Sighting:** The page reports a sighting on March 13, 1980, at Lac des Montagnes, Quebec. The object was stationary for approximately 20 minutes, then moved in circles, became stationary again, moved from left to right, and then reversed, described as very fast moving. The duration of the sighting was one and a half hours. The object was stationary over the lake at an altitude of about 4,000 feet.

**Object:** The object was white with red lights and was brighter than a star. It was star and triangular in shape, with the size of a large aircraft. No sound was reported.

**Aftermath:** The report is classified as unclassified and was routed to the National Research Council in Ottawa.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Robert Baillard。

**目击：** 该页面报告了1980年3月13日在魁北克省Lac des Montagnes发生的一起目击事件。该物体静止了约20分钟，然后盘旋移动，再次静止，随后从左向右移动并反转，被描述为移动速度非常快。目击持续时间为一小时三十分钟。该物体在湖面上方约4,000英尺处保持静止。

**物体：** 该物体为白色，带有红色灯光，比星星更亮。它呈星形和三角形，大小如同一架大型飞机。报告称没有声音。

**后续：** 该报告被归类为非机密，并被转送至渥太华的国家研究委员会。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Don Spence of Lloydminster, Canada, and Ms. Shelly Weber of Lloydminster, Canada.

**Sighting:** The object was sighted on 80 MAR 16 in the Fort Pitt District, Saskatchewan, at approximately 2130 hrs, M.S.T. It was first seen in the northern sky and remained visible for approximately two hours.

**Object:** The object was described as an oval-shaped bright light with a long upside-down "V" coming out of the bottom. The "V" was blue in colour, and there was a small red light on the left side of the "V". The object moved to the northwest and appeared to hover in that position.

**Aftermath:** The RCMP Onion Lake Detachment reported that they have been unable to determine what the object was and have exhausted all avenues of investigation.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:

**目击：** 该物体于 80 年 3 月 16 日在萨斯喀彻温省 Fort Pitt 区被目击，时间约为山区标准时间 2130 时。物体最初出现在北部天空，可见时间持续约两小时。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为一个椭圆形的明亮光点，底部延伸出一个倒置的“V”字形。该“V”字形为蓝色，且在“V”字形的左侧有一个小红灯。物体向西北方向移动，并似乎悬停在该位置。

**后续：** 加拿大皇家骑警 Onion Lake 分队报告称，他们无法确定该物体是什么，并且已经耗尽了所有调查途径。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Maurice Boutet, residing at 4901 Michelle Drive, Hanmer, Ontario.

**Sighting:** On April 22, 1972, at 0215Z, the witness observed an object due east of the village of Hanmer. The weather conditions included thin broken clouds with an estimated ceiling of 25,000 feet overcast and 15 miles visibility.

**Object:** The object appeared to look like an aircraft on fire. It was difficult to look at due to its brightness. While the observer was watching, a part of the object appeared to drop off, also in flames. The duration of the sighting was approximately 2 minutes.

**Aftermath:** Sudbury Airport was contacted to determine if any aircraft were airborne in the area. They reported one aircraft was airborne, but its position was approximately 30 miles north of the city of Sudbury. The observer stated he was about to get his wife to look at the object when it disappeared.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 居住在安大略省汉默（Hanmer）米歇尔大道（Michelle Drive）4901号的莫里斯·布泰（Maurice Boutet）先生。

**目击：** 1972年4月22日0215Z，目击者在汉默村以东观察到一个物体。当时天气状况为薄云，估计云底高度为25,000英尺，能见度15英里。

**物体：** 该物体看起来像一架着火的飞机。由于其亮度极高，难以直视。在观察过程中，物体的一部分似乎脱落，同样带有火焰。目击持续时间约为2分钟。

**后续：** 萨德伯里（Sudbury）机场被联系以核实当时是否有飞机在空中。机场报告称有一架飞机在空中，但其位置在萨德伯里市以北约30英里处。目击者称，他正准备叫妻子一起来看时，物体就消失了。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Two members of the Prince George Rural Detachment of the RCMP.

**Sighting:** On May 4, 1972, at 4:30 AM, witnesses observed a bright white light heading south over the Prince George Airport. The sighting lasted for approximately 20 minutes under clear skies.

**Object:** The object was circular in shape and appeared to be about three times the size of the stars, but much brighter. It slowed down, performed a rapid vertical rise, and decreased in size as it ascended. It then moved eastward in a jerky, zig-zag path, stopped to oscillate in one spot, and subsequently moved in a zig-zag path toward the northwest.

**Aftermath:** No sound was heard, and there were no bursts, tails, or shadows noted on the light. The report was filed by the Prince George Sub Division of the RCMP to the NRC Meteor Centre.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 两名加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）乔治王子城农村分局的成员。

**目击：** 1972年5月4日凌晨4点30分，目击者观察到一束明亮的白光向南飞越乔治王子城机场。在晴朗的天空下，目击持续了约20分钟。

**物体：** 该物体呈圆形，看起来大约是星星大小的三倍，但亮度要高得多。它减速后进行了快速垂直上升，并在上升过程中尺寸减小。随后，它以颠簸的“之”字形路径向东移动，停下来在一个点上摆动，接着又以“之”字形路径向西北方向移动。

**后续：** 现场未听到任何声音，也没有观察到光束、尾迹或阴影。该报告由加拿大皇家骑警乔治王子城分区提交给加拿大国家研究委员会（NRC）流星中心。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. Nelma Graham, Mr. Gordon Graham

**Date / Time:** May 1, 1972, at 12:15 AM ADST; May 2, 1972, at 12:40 AM ADST

**Location:** Maple Ridge, New Brunswick

**Sighting:** 
On May 1, 1972, at approximately 12:15 AM ADST, Mrs. Nelma Graham observed an unidentified object from her home. She maintained observation of the object for approximately 20 minutes before it disappeared over the horizon. Her husband, Mr. Gordon Graham, also observed the object for a duration of approximately 10 minutes during this initial sighting. 

A second, identical sighting occurred at the same location the following night, May 2, 1972. This event began at 12:40 AM ADST and lasted until approximately 1:00 AM ADST. During both sightings, the sky was clear with the moon visible in the eastern sky. The witnesses reported that the object was positioned in the north-west sky and appeared to be flying at a very high altitude.

**Object:** 
The object was described as being quite large and distinctively cross-shaped. It displayed a prominent red color, specifically noted as a blinking red light. Regarding its movement, accounts vary slightly: one report states the object did not move vertically but moved continuously, while another report indicates it moved vertically and continuously. No sound was heard by the witnesses during the observation.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The Fredericton Detachment of the RCMP was alerted to the sightings via a report in the local newspaper, *The Daily Gleaner*. Following their review, the RCMP forwarded a radio-gram regarding the incident to the National Research Council (NRC) Meteor Centre on May 4, 1972. The investigating officers noted that the witnesses appeared to be upstanding citizens. No further official action was taken by the RCMP regarding the matter.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 内尔玛·格雷厄姆夫人 (Mrs. Nelma Graham)、戈登·格雷厄姆先生 (Mr. Gordon Graham)

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年5月1日凌晨12:15（大西洋夏令时间）；1972年5月2日凌晨12:40（大西洋夏令时间）

**地点：** 新不伦瑞克省，枫树岭 (Maple Ridge, New Brunswick)

**目击经过：**
1972年5月1日凌晨12:15左右，内尔玛·格雷厄姆夫人在家中观察到了一个不明飞行物。她对该物体进行了约20分钟的持续观察，随后物体消失在地平线外。她的丈夫戈登·格雷厄姆先生在这次初步目击中也观察了该物体约10分钟。

次日（1972年5月2日）同一地点再次发生了完全相同的目击事件。该事件始于凌晨12:40，持续至凌晨1:00左右。两次目击期间，天空晴朗，月亮可见于东部天空。据目击者称，该物体位于西北方天空，且飞行高度极高。

**物体描述：**
该物体被描述为体型相当巨大，且呈现出独特的十字形状。它显示出醒目的红色，具体表现为闪烁的红光。关于其运动方式，描述略有出入：一份报告称该物体没有垂直移动，而是持续平移；另一份报告则指出它进行了持续的垂直移动。目击者在观察过程中未听到任何声音。

**调查/后续：**
加拿大皇家骑警 (RCMP) 弗雷德里克顿分局通过当地报纸《每日拾穗者》(The Daily Gleaner) 的报道获悉了这些目击事件。在进行审查后，加拿大皇家骑警于1972年5月4日向国家研究委员会 (NRC) 流星中心发送了一份关于此事件的无线电报。调查警官指出，目击者看起来是正直的公民。加拿大皇家骑警未就此事采取进一步的官方行动。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. F. Fandrey.

**Sighting:** On June 5, 1972, at 12:05 AM CST, the witness observed an object in the sky under clear conditions. The object was reported to have been seen every night since the last week of April, between 11:55 PM and 12:30 AM.

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** F. Fandrey 夫人。

**目击：** 1972 年 6 月 5 日凌晨 12:05（中部标准时间），目击者在晴朗的天空下观察到一个物体。据报告，自 4 月最后一周以来，该物体每晚在晚上 11:55 至凌晨 12:30 之间都会出现。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. S. Seguin, his wife, and potentially other individuals.

**Sighting:** The event occurred on May 8, 1972, between 0320Z and 0400Z in clear sky conditions. The observer was located en route to his home and at his home in Point Gatineau, P.Q.

**Object:** The object moved down towards the ground and then back up. Its color changed from white to red. It appeared three times larger than a star, and its shape was obscured by its brightness. It produced no sound and left no trail.

**Aftermath:** The observation lasted for 40 minutes. Approximately 25 feet of movie film was captured of the object using a Bell and Howell Super 8 camera, with footage taken from different angles.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** S. 塞甘（S. Seguin）先生、其妻子，以及其他可能的目击者。

**日期：** 1972年5月8日，格林威治标准时间（Z）03:20至04:00之间，当时天空晴朗。

**地点：** 目击者在前往魁北克省加蒂诺角（Point Gatineau, P.Q.）的途中及其家中。

**目击经过：** 该物体向地面移动，随后又升回空中。其颜色由白色变为红色。它看起来比恒星大三倍，由于亮度过高，其形状难以辨认。该物体在移动过程中未发出任何声音，也未留下任何尾迹。

**调查/后续：** 观测过程持续了40分钟。目击者使用一台贝尔-豪威尔（Bell and Howell）Super 8摄像机拍摄了约25英尺长的胶片，记录了该物体在不同角度下的影像。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** A man from Willow Point (unnamed), Bob House (Upper Islander photographer).

**Date / Time:** May 1972 (Monday sighting, Tuesday follow-up).

**Location:** Quadra Island, British Columbia.

**Sighting:** A man from Willow Point observed a circular, discus-shaped object hovering over Quadra Island on a Monday. The witness reported that the object remained in the sky for approximately 15 minutes. According to the witness, the object moved “around like a top,” hovering almost motionless before it began to wobble and tilt to one side. It then shuddered and climbed almost vertically for approximately 1,000 feet. After leveling off, the object departed on a zig-zag course toward the north at a “fantastic speed,” at which point the witness lost sight of it. The witness explicitly rejected the possibility that the object was a conventional aircraft, such as a plane or helicopter.

**Object:** The object was described as a circular, discus-shaped craft with no wings, no rotors, and no visible markings. Its surface had a dull sheen, described as looking “like dirty chrome.” The object featured lights around its rim that flashed on and off in a seemingly random sequence. Its movement was characterized by spinning, wobbling, tilting, shuddering, and high-speed zig-zagging.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The witness took seven photographs of the object during the sighting. He requested that *The Upper Islander* newspaper develop the film and forward the images to the military for identification. *Upper Islander* photographer Bob House stated on the following Tuesday that only one of the seven photographs was printable. Specialists at CFB Comox were tasked with attempting to identify the object captured in the photograph.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名来自威洛角（Willow Point）的男子（未透露姓名），鲍勃·豪斯（Bob House，上岛报社摄影师）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年5月（周一目击，周二后续跟进）。

**地点：** 不列颠哥伦比亚省，夸德拉岛（Quadra Island）。

**目击经过：** 一名来自威洛角的男子于周一观察到一个圆形的圆盘状物体悬停在夸德拉岛上空。据目击者报告，该物体在空中停留了约15分钟。据其描述，该物体“像陀螺一样旋转”，在几乎静止悬停后开始晃动并向一侧倾斜。随后，它发生震颤并几乎垂直向上爬升了约1000英尺。在平稳飞行后，该物体以“惊人的速度”呈之字形向北飞去，随后目击者失去了对它的视线。目击者明确排除了该物体是飞机或直升机等常规飞行器的可能性。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一种圆形的圆盘状飞行器，没有机翼、没有旋翼，也没有可见的标识。其表面呈现出一种暗淡的光泽，被形容为“像脏铬金属”。物体边缘环绕着灯光，以看似随机的顺序闪烁。其运动特征表现为旋转、晃动、倾斜、震颤以及高速的之字形飞行。

**调查/后续：** 目击者在目击过程中拍摄了七张该物体的照片。他要求《上岛报》（*The Upper Islander*）冲洗胶卷，并将照片转交给军方进行鉴定。上岛报社摄影师鲍勃·豪斯于次周二表示，七张照片中只有一张可以冲印出来。科莫克斯加拿大空军基地（CFB Comox）的专家随后负责尝试识别照片中拍摄到的物体。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Orrland Ericson, and RCMP Constables DF Ferrel, WJ Rideout, and LE Ryll.

**Sighting:** On May 22, 1972, at 11:15 PM CST, in clear skies, an object was sighted near 1637 Warren Ave, Weyburn, Saskatchewan. The object was observed from directly below, appearing round and approximately 1500 feet high. It appeared about half the size of the moon, decreasing in size as the distance increased. The brightness varied from dull orange to bright orange, resembling fire. It left no trail and made no noise.

**Object:** The object was easily seen for approximately 18 miles westward from Weyburn before it disappeared. It appeared to disappear for 30-second intervals. Sometimes its speed seemed to increase.

**Aftermath:** The object was followed by a police car for approximately [unclear] NNW from Weyburn until it could no longer be seen. Mr. John Hodges of the Regina, Saskatchewan National Research Council committee was advised at approximately 12:30 AM on May 23. No further information was received.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Orrland Ericson，以及加拿大皇家骑警警员 DF Ferrel、WJ Rideout 和 LE Ryll。

**目击：** 1972年5月22日晚上11:15（中部标准时间），在天空晴朗的情况下，萨斯喀彻温省韦伯恩市 Warren 大道1637号附近发现了一个物体。该物体从正下方被观测到，呈圆形，高度约为1500英尺。它看起来大约有月亮的一半大小，随着距离增加而变小。亮度在暗橙色到亮橙色之间变化，类似于火光。它没有留下尾迹，也没有发出声音。

**物体：** 该物体在从韦伯恩向西约18英里的范围内很容易被看到，随后消失。它似乎每隔约30秒消失一次。有时它的速度似乎会增加。

**后续：** 一辆警车跟随该物体从韦伯恩向北偏西北方向行驶了约[不清晰]距离，直到无法再看到它。萨斯喀彻温省里贾纳国家研究委员会的 John Hodges 先生于5月23日凌晨12:30左右收到通知。此后未收到进一步信息。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Miss Ann Warren, 12 years old.

**Sighting:** On May 25, 1972, at 0900Z, the witness was at a house located on a hill at 10 Mile Point, Victoria. The weather was clear with 10 miles visibility and calm winds.

**Object:** The witness reported hearing a screeching vowel sound after her cat woke her up with strange antics. She observed three very low purple red flashing lights. The object either circled the house three times or there were three of them. The duration of the sighting was approximately five minutes.

**Aftermath:** The report was sent from the Rescue Coordinator Centre in Victoria to the National Research Council and Canadian Forces Headquarters in Ottawa.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 12岁的安·沃伦（Miss Ann Warren）小姐。

**目击：** 1972年5月25日0900Z，目击者位于维多利亚10英里点（10 Mile Point）的一座山上的房子里。当时天气晴朗，能见度10英里，风力平静。

**物体：** 目击者称在猫因奇怪的举动将她唤醒后，听到了一种尖锐的元音声音。她观察到三个非常低的紫色红色闪烁灯光。该物体要么绕着房子转了三圈，要么就是有三个物体。目击持续时间约为五分钟。

**后续：** 该报告由维多利亚救援协调中心发送至加拿大国家研究委员会和渥太华加拿大军队总部。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Andrew Dufrense (also spelled Dufense), Robert Ashmead, Earl R. Anderson, Lee Murphy, and Cecilia Murphy.

**Date / Time:** May 26, 1972; sightings began between 2:00 AM and 3:00 AM MST.

**Location:** Highway 35, north of Paddle Prairie, Alberta, continuing to the Murphy residence near High Level, Alberta.

**Sighting:** On May 26, 1972, at approximately 2:00–3:00 AM, a group of five witnesses traveling north on Highway 35 from Paddle Prairie observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon. Andrew Dufrense, Robert Ashmead, and Earl R. Anderson first encountered the object 5 miles north of Paddle Prairie. The object maintained a constant distance (estimated between 200 and 500 yards) and altitude (500 to 1,000 feet) relative to their vehicle. When the witnesses increased their speed to 85 mph, the object accelerated to match them, moving randomly from side to side across the road without ever falling behind.

While in transit, the witnesses contacted Lee Murphy via truck radio 15 miles south of High Level. Upon arriving at the Murphy residence at approximately 2:30 AM, Lee and Cecilia Murphy joined the others in observing the phenomenon. Witnesses reported that the object(s) appeared to divide or split into groups of 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6 pieces at random intervals. The objects were observed in the west, appearing to cluster together with one remaining separate. They were noted to appear and disappear frequently. The sighting lasted approximately one hour, ending when the objects departed rapidly toward the northwest in the direction of Footner Lake Airport. Earl Anderson attempted to track the objects with binoculars upon arriving home, but they had vanished.

**Object:** The objects were described as black, grayish-black, or oblong in shape, occasionally resembling clouds. Some accounts noted a tail-like feature on the left or right side. They possessed no lights, emitted no sound, and maintained an altitude of 500 to 1,000 feet. Their movement was characterized by rapid acceleration, random lateral shifts, and the ability to split into multiple distinct entities before disappearing.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The RCMP conducted an investigation led by Cst. R.D. Stair. Official inquiries were made with the Department of Transport at Footner Lake Airport, which confirmed no incoming traffic during the time of the sighting, though one light aircraft departed at 5:30 AM. Cst. Stair noted that the witnesses were local residents considered to be reliable, though one witness (Robert Ashmead) disclosed he had consumed approximately one dozen beers between noon on May 25 and the time of the sighting. A formal statement was taken on May 28, 1972, at 8:30 PM in High Level. R.D. Stair concluded the file by stating that no further investigation was required.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 安德鲁·杜弗伦斯（Andrew Dufrense，亦拼作 Dufense）、罗伯特·阿什米德（Robert Ashmead）、厄尔·R·安德森（Earl R. Anderson）、李·墨菲（Lee Murphy）以及塞西莉亚·墨菲（Cecilia Murphy）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年5月26日；目击事件始于山区标准时间（MST）凌晨2:00至3:00之间。

**地点：** 阿尔伯塔省帕德尔草原（Paddle Prairie）以北的35号公路，并延伸至阿尔伯塔省海莱弗尔（High Level）附近的墨菲住所。

**目击经过：** 1972年5月26日凌晨约2:00至3:00，五名目击者乘车沿35号公路从帕德尔草原向北行驶时，观察到一种不明空中现象。安德鲁·杜弗伦斯、罗伯特·阿什米德和厄尔·R·安德森在帕德尔草原以北5英里处首次遭遇该物体。该物体与他们的车辆保持着恒定的距离（估计在200至500码之间）和高度（500至1,000英尺）。当目击者将车速提高到每小时85英里时，该物体也随之加速以保持同步，并在道路两侧随机移动，始终未被甩在身后。

在行驶途中，目击者通过卡车无线电联系了位于海莱弗尔以南15英里的李·墨菲。大约凌晨2:30抵达墨菲住所后，李·墨菲和塞西莉亚·墨菲也加入了观察行列。据目击者报告，该物体（或多个物体）似乎会随机分裂成2、3、4、5或6个部分。这些物体出现在西方，看起来聚在一起，其中一个保持独立。据记录，它们频繁地出现又消失。目击过程持续了约一小时，最终这些物体迅速向西北方向的富特纳湖机场（Footner Lake Airport）飞去并消失。厄尔·安德森在回到家后曾试图用双筒望远镜追踪这些物体，但它们已经不见踪影。

**物体描述：** 这些物体被描述为黑色、灰黑色或长方形，有时看起来像云。一些描述提到其左侧或右侧有类似尾巴的特征。它们没有灯光，没有发出任何声音，并保持在500至1,000英尺的高度。其运动特点是快速加速、随机横向移动，并具有在消失前分裂成多个独立实体的能力。

**调查/后续：** 加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）由R.D.斯泰尔（R.D. Stair）警官负责进行调查。官方对富特纳湖机场的交通部门进行了问询，确认在目击期间没有进港航班，仅有一架轻型飞机在凌晨5:30起飞。斯泰尔警官指出，目击者均为当地居民，被认为是可靠的，尽管其中一名目击者（罗伯特·阿什米德）透露他在5月25日中午至目击发生期间饮用了约一打啤酒。1972年5月28日晚8:30，警方在海莱弗尔获取了正式陈述。R.D.斯泰尔在结案报告中称，无需进行进一步调查。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Fred Bare, Fred Bare’s daughter, Barney Enyedy, Matilda Enyedy, Mel Marshal, Don Repen, Gordon Delgatty, and Thomas Skelton.

**Date / Time:** June 10, 1972; sightings reported between 10:45 PM and 11:50 PM.

**Location:** Bonanza, Alberta.

**Sighting:** On the night of June 10, 1972, multiple residents in the Bonanza area reported anomalous aerial phenomena. At 10:45 PM, Fred Bare and his daughter observed an object approximately 8 miles northwest of Bonanza. The daughter initially mistook the object for a shooting star. Fred Bare reported that the object was positioned roughly 4 miles west of Bonanza at an altitude of 2,000 feet. He observed the object explode in mid-air, followed by the appearance of smoke.

Later that night, at 11:50 PM, a separate group consisting of Barney Enyedy, Matilda Enyedy, Mel Marshal, and Don Repen reported a different encounter. They observed an object hovering above them at an altitude of approximately 300 to 400 feet. This sighting lasted for about 5 minutes before the object faded and disappeared. The witnesses claimed that the object set fire to the ground directly beneath its hovering position.

**Object:** The descriptions provided by the witnesses varied significantly. Fred Bare described the object as having the intensity of a bright aircraft landing light. Conversely, the group including Barney Enyedy described the object as a round, highly illuminated circle featuring spikes all around its perimeter. They noted the object was bright red and emitted flames from its underside. Official investigation later identified the objects as three Navy C-3 hand-fired parachute flares.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The RCMP Spirit River Detachment conducted an investigation into the reports. While Barney Enyedy was the only member of his group interviewed by the RCMP at the time, the investigation eventually led to the identification of the source. Gordon Delgatty, a resident of Inuvik, NWT, admitted to firing the flares from the residence of Thomas Skelton in Bonanza. Delgatty, a former Navy serviceman, explained that he fired one flare during daylight hours and two additional flares after dark because he did not wish to transport the ordnance back to Inuvik. Following this admission, the RCMP concluded the investigation and sought guidance on whether further action was necessary. The RCMP had previously been instructed to advise Professor Folinsbee of the University of Alberta regarding the initial reports.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 弗雷德·贝尔（Fred Bare）、弗雷德·贝尔的女儿、巴尼·恩耶迪（Barney Enyedy）、玛蒂尔达·恩耶迪（Matilda Enyedy）、梅尔·马歇尔（Mel Marshal）、唐·雷彭（Don Repen）、戈登·德尔加蒂（Gordon Delgatty）以及托马斯·斯凯尔顿（Thomas Skelton）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年6月10日；目击报告时间介于晚上10:45至11:50之间。

**地点：** 阿尔伯塔省博南扎（Bonanza, Alberta）。

**目击经过：** 1972年6月10日晚，博南扎地区的几位居民报告了异常空中现象。晚上10:45，弗雷德·贝尔及其女儿在博南扎西北约8英里处观察到一个物体。起初，他的女儿误以为那是流星。弗雷德·贝尔称，该物体位于博南扎以西约4英里处，高度约为2000英尺。他观察到该物体在半空中爆炸，随后出现了烟雾。

当晚晚些时候，即晚上11:50，由巴尼·恩耶迪、玛蒂尔达·恩耶迪、梅尔·马歇尔和唐·雷彭组成的另一组人报告了不同的遭遇。他们观察到一个物体悬停在他们上方约300至400英尺的高度。这次目击持续了约5分钟，随后物体逐渐变淡并消失。目击者声称，该物体使其悬停位置正下方的地面起火。

**物体描述：** 目击者提供的描述差异很大。弗雷德·贝尔形容该物体具有明亮的飞机着陆灯强度。相反，包括巴尼·恩耶迪在内的小组则将该物体描述为一个圆形、高度发光的圆环，其周边带有尖刺。他们指出该物体呈亮红色，底部喷射出火焰。官方调查随后认定这些物体为三枚海军C-3手持式降落伞照明弹。

**调查/后续：** 加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）斯皮里特河（Spirit River）分队对这些报告进行了调查。尽管当时巴尼·恩耶迪是其小组中唯一接受皇家骑警采访的成员，但调查最终确定了来源。来自西北地区伊努维克（Inuvik）的居民戈登·德尔加蒂承认，他在博南扎的托马斯·斯凯尔顿住所处发射了这些照明弹。德尔加蒂曾是一名海军军人，他解释说，由于不想将这些军火带回伊努维克，他在白天发射了一枚照明弹，天黑后又发射了两枚。在此供述后，皇家骑警结束了调查，并就是否有必要采取进一步行动寻求指导。皇家骑警此前曾接到指示，需将初步报告告知阿尔伯塔大学的福林斯比（Folinsbee）教授。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Lucien Daigle, Charles Bosse

**Date / Time:** June 24, 1972, at 8:30 PM

**Location:** One mile west of the Garden of the Republic Provincial Park, St. Jacques, Madawaska County, New Brunswick.

**Sighting:** On the evening of June 24, 1972, a UFO sighting was reported in St. Jacques, New Brunswick. Witness Charles Bosse observed an anomalous event at 8:30 PM while in an area one mile west of the Garden of the Republic Provincial Park. According to Bosse, the sky was cloudy at the time of the sighting. He reported seeing a very bright, red-orange fire that he estimated to be approximately the size of a motor vehicle. The object remained visible for a duration of two minutes, during which it traveled from the south-east to the north-west at an altitude estimated between 500 and 1,000 feet. Bosse noted that the object produced a distinct sound, which he described as resembling the discharge of a firearm.

**Object:** The object was described as a very bright, red-orange fire, roughly the size of a motor vehicle. It exhibited a steady movement from the south-east to the north-west at an altitude of 500 to 1,000 feet. The duration of the sighting was two minutes, and the object emitted a sound comparable to the discharge of a firearm. Official investigation later identified the object as a survival flare rocket.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** Following the report, an official investigation was conducted into the sighting in St. Jacques, Madawaska County. As part of the inquiry, local airports were contacted to determine if any aircraft were missing or in distress; all airports reported no missing planes. The investigation ultimately concluded that the object sighted was a survival flare rocket. It was determined that the flare had been discharged by Lucien Daigle, who served as a Steamship Inspector for the Department of Transport and was present at the location. Based on this identification, the file was closed with no further reports to follow.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 吕西安·戴格 (Lucien Daigle)、查尔斯·博塞 (Charles Bosse)

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年6月24日，晚上8:30

**地点：** 新不伦瑞克省马达瓦斯卡县圣雅克 (St. Jacques)，共和国花园省立公园以西一英里处。

**目击经过：** 1972年6月24日晚，新不伦瑞克省圣雅克发生了一起UFO目击事件。目击者查尔斯·博塞于晚上8:30在共和国花园省立公园以西一英里处观察到了这一异常现象。据博塞描述，当时天空多云。他报告称看到了一团非常明亮的红橙色火球，估计大小与一辆机动车相当。该物体持续可见两分钟，期间从东南方向向西北方向移动，飞行高度估计在500至1,000英尺之间。博塞指出，该物体发出了一种独特的声音，他形容其类似于枪支发射的声音。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一团非常明亮的红橙色火球，大小约相当于一辆机动车。它以稳定的轨迹从东南向西北移动，高度在500至1,000英尺之间。目击持续时间为两分钟，物体发出了类似于枪支发射的声音。官方调查随后确认该物体为一枚求生信号弹。

**调查/后续：** 事件发生后，针对马达瓦斯卡县圣雅克的这起目击事件进行了官方调查。作为调查的一部分，相关部门联系了当地机场，以确定是否有飞机失踪或处于紧急状态；所有机场均报告没有飞机失踪。调查最终得出结论，所目击的物体是一枚求生信号弹。经查明，该信号弹是由当时在现场的交通部轮船检查员吕西安·戴格发射的。基于这一结论，该档案被结案，后续未再有相关报告。

**Witnesses:** Ralph G. Chamberlain of Lincoln Park, Michigan.

**Sighting:** On July 5, 1972, at approximately 4:10 am, the witness observed an object from the Ford Motor Rouge Plant. The witness also reported a similar, though "more fuzzy," sighting on July 6, and noted no sighting on July 7 due to overcast conditions.

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mme Donna Mercer (Mrs. Leo Mercier), M. John Lunan (school principal), a journalist from *Le Droit*, a Glen Cairn housewife, Lawson Smith, approximately thirty local residents, and the OPP at Bells Corners.

**Date / Time:** July 18, 1972, between 12:25 AM and 02:30 AM EDT (with reports of a recurring light over four consecutive nights at 1:00 AM).

**Location:** Campbells Bay, QC; Glen Cairn (Kanata), ON; and surrounding regions including Chapeau, Westmeath, and Petawawa.

**Sighting:** On July 18, 1972, a significant wave of sightings occurred. Between 12:25 AM and 01:45 AM, Mrs. Leo Mercier and several others observed an object in the North. Simultaneously, in the Glen Cairn area of Kanata, a housewife reported an arrow-shaped object, while the OPP at Bells Corners received six calls between 1:00 AM and 2:30 AM regarding aerial phenomena. 

Mme Donna Mercer reported observing a mysterious light for four consecutive nights at 1:00 AM. This led to gatherings of approximately thirty people in her yard, including M. John Lunan and a journalist from *Le Droit*. M. Lunan observed the light through a telescope, noting it moved significantly faster than a satellite. While some reports were dismissed as potential crank calls, the OPP noted that most appeared legitimate. Similar sightings have been documented in the region over the previous three years, including reports in Chapeau, Westmeath, and Petawawa.

**Object:** Descriptions varied by witness and location. The object observed by Mrs. Mercier was star-like, approximately 3 feet across, and exhibited a "zigzag" motion before ascending. Its color shifted from orange to blue, accompanied by an "orange thrust." M. Lunan described the light as red at the top. The Glen Cairn housewife described an arrow-shaped object colored red and green. Mme Mercer described the object as a bright orange light, which she characterized as a "flying saucer."

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The sighting was reported to the Meteor Centre on July 19, 1972, by Mrs. Mary Gray of the Observatory Staff, with the message recorded by Mrs. Chénier. Local police (three officers) responded to Mme Mercer’s yard during the gatherings. A spokesperson at the weather office suggested the sightings might be related to the "northern lights" or "balls of lightning" reported the previous week at Campbells Bay. Lawson Smith, owner of the Pontiac Transit Mix gravel pit, suggested that the recurring orange light observed by Mme Mercer might be attributed to his welding equipment, though he noted that his equipment did not resemble the objects described by the residents. Historical context includes reports of circular burn marks found on the ground in Chapeau and Westmeath following previous sightings in those areas.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 唐娜·默瑟夫人（Donna Mercer，即 Leo Mercier 夫人）、约翰·卢南先生（John Lunan，校长）、一名来自《权利报》（*Le Droit*）的记者、一名格伦凯恩（Glen Cairn）的家庭主妇、劳森·史密斯（Lawson Smith）、约三十名当地居民，以及贝尔斯角（Bells Corners）的安大略省警察局（OPP）警员。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年7月18日，美国东部时间凌晨12:25至凌晨02:30之间（据报告，在连续四个夜晚的凌晨1:00均出现了重复出现的光点）。

**地点：** 魁北克省坎贝尔湾（Campbells Bay）；安大略省格伦凯恩（卡纳塔）；以及包括沙波（Chapeau）、韦斯特米斯（Westmeath）和佩塔瓦瓦（Petawawa）在内的周边地区。

**目击经过：** 1972年7月18日，发生了一波重大的目击事件。凌晨12:25至01:45之间，Leo Mercier 夫人及其他几人观察到了北方的一个物体。与此同时，在卡纳塔的格伦凯恩地区，一名家庭主妇报告称看到了一个箭形的物体；而贝尔斯角的安大略省警察局在凌晨1:00至2:30之间接到了六个关于空中现象的报警电话。

唐娜·默瑟夫人报告称，连续四个夜晚的凌晨1:00都观察到了神秘的光点。这引得约三十人聚集在她的院子里，其中包括约翰·卢南先生和一名《权利报》的记者。卢南先生通过望远镜观察了该光点，指出其移动速度明显快于卫星。虽然一些报告被视为可能的恶作剧电话，但安大略省警察局指出，大多数报告看起来是真实的。过去三年里，该地区也记录过类似的目击事件，包括在沙波、韦斯特米斯和佩塔瓦瓦的报告。

**物体描述：** 不同目击者和地点的描述各不相同。Mercer 夫人观察到的物体呈星状，直径约3英尺，在上升前呈现出“之”字形运动。其颜色从橙色变为蓝色，并伴有“橙色的推力”。卢南先生描述该光点顶部为红色。格伦凯恩的家庭主妇描述该物体呈箭形，颜色为红绿相间。默瑟夫人则将该物体描述为明亮的橙色光点，并称其为“飞碟”。

**调查/后续：** 1972年7月19日，天文台工作人员玛丽·格雷（Mary Gray）夫人将此次目击事件报告给了流星中心，并由谢尼耶（Chénier）夫人记录了相关信息。在聚集期间，当地警方（三名警官）曾前往默瑟夫人的院子进行响应。气象局的一位发言人建议，这些目击事件可能与前一周在坎贝尔湾报告的“北极光”或“球状闪电”有关。庞蒂亚克搅拌站（Pontiac Transit Mix）砂石坑的所有者劳森·史密斯表示，默瑟夫人观察到的重复出现的橙色光点可能归因于他的焊接设备，但他同时也指出，他的设备与居民们描述的物体并不相似。历史背景包括在沙波和韦斯特米斯，此前目击事件后曾在地面上发现过圆形灼烧痕迹。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Jim McGregor, Mrs. McGregor, Mrs. William Laws, Perry Laws, Gerllaune Laws, Mr. R. Bouchard.

**Date / Time:** July 28, 1972. Specific times reported include 02:10 and 05:00.

**Location:** Hanmer, Ontario (specifically 4286 Theresa Street and 4186 Roy Avenue).

**Sighting:** 
The Hanmer, Ontario sightings of July 28, 1972, involved multiple reports from residents in the area. According to the report involving Mr. Jim McGregor, Mrs. McGregor, and Mr. R. Bouchard at 4286 Theresa Street, the witnesses observed a very large, oblong-shaped object on a clear, starlight night. This object featured alternating flashing green, red, and white lights. It was observed at a very high altitude and appeared to decrease in size as it moved due west over a duration of 40 minutes.

A separate report involving Mr. Jim McGregor, Mrs. William Laws, Perry Laws, and Gerllaune Laws (of 4186 Roy Ave) details two distinct observations. The first occurred at 05:00, involving an object displaying flashing red, green, and white lights that headed south-westerly for a duration of 1 hour and 40 minutes. The second observation by this group occurred at 02:10, involving a round white object observed at an altitude of 1,000 feet for a duration of 3 minutes; this object was noted for having bright lights on its bottom.

**Object:** 
The sightings involved two distinct object descriptions. The first was a very large, oblong-shaped craft featuring alternating flashing green, red, and white lights, which appeared to be at a high altitude and moved due west. The second was a round, white object observed at 1,000 feet, characterized by bright lights on its underside. Movement varied between a south-westerly trajectory and a westward path, with durations ranging from 3 minutes to 1 hour and 40 minutes.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The reports were officially documented and transmitted via telex to the National Research Council (NRC) Radio and Electrical Engineering Division. Meteorological data was obtained from the Sudbury Met Office for the time of the sightings, confirming clear skies, a temperature of 50 degrees Fahrenheit, and winds blowing from 310 degrees at 5 mph.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 吉姆·麦格雷戈先生 (Mr. Jim McGregor)、麦格雷戈夫人 (Mrs. McGregor)、威廉·劳斯夫人 (Mrs. William Laws)、佩里·劳斯 (Perry Laws)、格劳恩·劳斯 (Gerllaune Laws)、R. 布沙尔先生 (Mr. R. Bouchard)。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年7月28日。报告的具体时间包括凌晨02:10和05:00。

**地点：** 安大略省汉默（具体为特蕾莎街4286号和罗伊大道4186号）。

**目击经过：** 
1972年7月28日发生在安大略省汉默的目击事件涉及当地居民的多份报告。根据特蕾莎街4286号的吉姆·麦格雷戈先生、麦格雷戈夫人和R. 布沙尔先生的报告，目击者在一个晴朗的星夜观察到一个非常巨大的长方形物体。该物体闪烁着交替的绿色、红色和白色灯光。它在极高的高度被观测到，并在向正西方向移动的过程中，持续40分钟后看起来体积逐渐变小。

另一份涉及吉姆·麦格雷戈先生、威廉·劳斯夫人、佩里·劳斯和格劳恩·劳斯（罗伊大道4186号）的报告详细描述了两次不同的观测。第一次发生在05:00，涉及一个闪烁着红、绿、白灯光的物体，它向西南方向移动，持续时间为1小时40分钟。该小组的第二次观测发生在02:10，涉及一个圆形的白色物体，在1000英尺的高度被观测到，持续时间为3分钟；该物体的底部有明亮的灯光。

**物体描述：** 
此次目击事件涉及两种不同的物体描述。第一种是一个非常巨大的长方形飞行器，带有交替闪烁的绿、红、白灯光，似乎处于高空并向正西方向移动。第二种是一个圆形的白色物体，在1000英尺高度被观测到，其特征是底部有明亮的灯光。物体的移动轨迹在西南方向和正西方向之间变化，持续时间从3分钟到1小时40分钟不等。

**调查/后续：** 
这些报告已被正式记录，并通过电传方式发送至加拿大国家研究委员会（NRC）无线电与电气工程部。调查人员从萨德伯里气象局获取了目击时间段的气象数据，证实当时天空晴朗，气温为华氏50度（约摄氏10度），风向为310度，风速为每小时5英里。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** An unnamed observer (refused identification), Mr. A. Tarsiuk, and Mrs. Tarsiuk.

**Date / Time:** July 26, 1972 (Tarsiuk sighting) and July 27, 1972, at 0550Z (Unnamed observer sighting).

**Location:** Grande Prairie and Sexsmith, Alberta.

**Sighting:** 
The case file documents two distinct reports regarding aerial phenomena in the Grande Prairie/Sexsmith area. 

On July 26, 1972, Mr. and Mrs. Tarsiuk, located at 10210 - 111 Ave in Grande Prairie, observed an object positioned 15 to 20 degrees above the horizon to the south of the city. The object traveled toward the southwest and remained visible for approximately 30 minutes before disappearing into a cloudy horizon.

On July 27, 1972, at 0550Z, an unnamed observer who declined to provide identification reported a separate sighting. This individual observed a single object flying at a high altitude northeast of the town of Sexsmith, heading in an easterly direction. This sighting also lasted for approximately 30 minutes.

**Object:** 
The descriptions provided by the witnesses differ in detail. Mr. and Mrs. Tarsiuk, utilizing binoculars, described the object as appearing the size of a headlight. It featured a dark center surrounded by a green outer ring and maintained a constant altitude throughout the observation. 

The unnamed observer described the object as displaying unsteady red and green lights while in flight.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The Tarsiuk report was formally transmitted to the National Research Council in Ottawa for further review. 

Regarding the July 27 sighting, official inquiries were conducted to correlate the report with known air traffic. Grande Prairie Airport control confirmed that there were no aircraft scheduled or reported flying in the area at the time of the sighting. However, radar data did detect a single contact in the vicinity. This radar contact was tracked heading at 120 degrees at an altitude of 4,800 feet, moving at a slow rate of speed. The radar contact was eventually lost at a distance of 195 miles at 0626Z.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名未具名观察者（拒绝透露身份）、A. 塔修克先生（Mr. A. Tarsiuk）及塔修克夫人（Mrs. Tarsiuk）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年7月26日（塔修克夫妇目击事件）及1972年7月27日0550Z（未具名观察者目击事件）。

**地点：** 阿尔伯塔省大草原城（Grande Prairie）及塞克斯史密斯（Sexsmith）。

**目击经过：**
该档案记录了关于大草原城/塞克斯史密斯地区空中现象的两起独立报告。

1972年7月26日，位于大草原城111大道10210号的塔修克夫妇观察到一个位于城市南部、地平线上方15至20度位置的物体。该物体向西南方向移动，在消失于多云的地平线之前，可见时间持续了约30分钟。

1972年7月27日0550Z，一名拒绝提供身份信息的未具名观察者报告了另一起目击事件。该目击者观察到一个单一物体在塞克斯史密斯镇东北方的高空飞行，航向为正东。此次目击过程同样持续了约30分钟。

**物体描述：**
目击者提供的描述在细节上有所不同。塔修克夫妇通过双筒望远镜观察，称该物体看起来像车前灯大小。它中心呈暗色，外围环绕着绿色光圈，在整个观察过程中保持高度不变。

未具名观察者则描述称，该物体在飞行时闪烁着不稳定的红光和绿光。

**调查/后续：**
塔修克夫妇的报告已被正式转交至渥太华的国家研究委员会（National Research Council）进行进一步审查。

关于7月27日的目击事件，官方进行了调查以核实该报告是否与已知空中交通有关。大草原城机场管制部门确认，在目击事件发生时，该地区没有预定或报告的飞行器。然而，雷达数据确实在该区域探测到了一个单一目标。该雷达目标被追踪到以120度航向、4800英尺高度缓慢飞行。该雷达目标最终于0626Z在195英里外消失。

**Witnesses:** Mr. Hewlitt (also identified as Mr. Hewlitt RC)

**Date / Time:** August 6, 1972, at 0540Z

**Location:** 674 Cowan St, Kamloops, BC

**Sighting:** 
On August 6, 1972, at 0540Z, Mr. Hewlitt observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon in the skies over Kamloops, British Columbia. The sighting lasted for a total duration of 10 minutes. At the time of the observation, the sky conditions were noted as having thin cloud cover. Mr. Hewlitt tracked the object as it moved in an easterly and northerly direction. The object was first sighted at a bearing of 350 degrees and maintained visibility until last contact at 015 degrees. Throughout the duration of the event, the object remained at an approximate 80-degree angle relative to the horizon.

**Object:** 
The object was described as being small in size. Its color was noted as amber to orange. While the specific altitude of the object could not be determined, it was observed at a high elevation (80-degree angle). No sound or specific structural details were reported beyond its color, size, and trajectory.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The sighting was formally documented and transmitted from CANDEFRAD Kamloops to the RCCWC/CANFORCEHED (Canadian Forces Headquarters) and the National Research Council Radio and Electrical Engineering Division. The documentation includes the witness's specific address at 674 Cowan St, Kamloops, BC. Official records note that the documentation provided across the files is considered a suspected duplicate of the same event.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 休利特先生（Hewlitt，亦被记录为休利特 RC 先生）

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年8月6日，0540Z（协调世界时）

**地点：** 不列颠哥伦比亚省坎卢普斯市考恩街674号

**目击经过：** 
1972年8月6日0540Z，休利特先生在不列颠哥伦比亚省坎卢普斯市上空观测到一个不明空中现象。此次目击事件持续了10分钟。观测时，天空状况为薄云覆盖。休利特先生追踪了该物体的移动轨迹，其移动方向为东向及北向。该物体最初在350度方位角被发现，并保持可见状态，直至015度方位角时最后一次观测到。在整个事件过程中，该物体相对于地平线保持在大约80度的仰角。

**物体描述：** 
该物体被描述为体积较小。其颜色为琥珀色至橙色。虽然无法确定该物体的具体高度，但观测显示其处于高海拔位置（80度仰角）。除颜色、大小和轨迹外，未报告任何声音或具体的结构细节。

**调查/后续：** 
此次目击事件已正式记录在案，并由坎卢普斯加拿大国防部（CANDEFRAD）转交至加拿大搜救协调中心（RCCWC）/加拿大武装部队总部（CANFORCEHED）以及加拿大国家研究委员会无线电与电气工程部。相关文档中包含了目击者的具体地址（坎卢普斯市考恩街674号）。官方记录指出，各档案中提供的相关文档被认为是同一事件的疑似重复记录。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Greg Faltersack, an 18-year-old youth.

**Sighting:** While driving home from visiting his girlfriend at approximately 2:30 a.m. on a county road in the northeastern part of Waukesha County, the witness experienced a complete electrical failure in his car. Upon applying his brakes, the car skidded 23 feet. After exiting the vehicle, the witness observed a large, orange object approximately 20 feet in diameter hovering about 40 feet above him at tree-top level. The object emitted a "beep, beep" sound before disappearing.

**Object:** A large, orange object, approximately 20 feet in diameter.

**Aftermath:** The witness reported the incident to the Waukesha County Sheriff's Department. Sgt. Herman Sprung stated that the witness seemed sincere and shaken. An inspection of the vehicle confirmed the witness's report, noting that the water in the car had boiled over, the fuse box had been blown out, and there were skid marks on the road. Sgt. Sprung stated that the department was not discounting the report as a hoax.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 18岁青年 Greg Faltersack。

**目击：** 当事人于凌晨2:30左右在沃基肖县（Waukesha County）东北部的乡村道路上驾车回家时，车辆发生完全电气故障。在刹车后，车辆滑行了23英尺。当事人下车后，看到一个直径约20英尺的巨大橙色物体悬浮在离他约40英尺高的树梢上方。该物体发出“哔、哔”声后消失。

**物体：** 一个直径约20英尺的巨大橙色物体。

**后续：** 当事人向沃基肖县治安官部门报告了此事件。警官 Herman Sprung 表示，当事人看起来很真诚且受到惊吓。对车辆的检查证实了当事人的报告，发现车内水已沸腾、保险丝盒被烧毁，且路面上有刹车痕迹。Sprung 警官表示，该部门并未将此报告视为恶作剧。

**Witnesses:** Mr. Denis Thul, four unnamed friends, and the President of Anglo Roulyn Mines.

**Sighting:** The page details two separate sighting areas. Area One (Caron, Mortlach, Parkbeg) involved sightings on September 10 and 11, 1972, with clear visibility and overcast conditions. CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Denis Thul 先生、四位未具名的朋友，以及 Anglo Roulyn 矿业公司总裁。

**物体：** 在区域一，物体被描述为带有微红色的暗白色光，它向见证者移动，随后改变航向并离开。在区域二，物体被描述为橄榄球形状，带有绿色、红色和蓝色的灯光。

**Sighting:** The event occurred on September 17, 1972, between approximately 17:00 and 18:15. The weather was described as perfectly clear and windy.

**Object:** The object was seen high in the sky toward the west, positioned close enough to the sun that observers had to shield their eyes. Initially, it had a silvery appearance like a high-flying jet, but later appeared greenish underneath. It seemed to have wings which "fluttered" and moved back and forth a bit without changing its general position. The observers heard the sound of a motor which they associated with the object.

**Aftermath:** The report was phoned to Mike Bryan as a second-hand report at 18:30.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:

**目击：** 1972年9月6日0730 Z，目击者正开车前往赫尔和渥太华之间的跨省大桥。她观察到一个位于东南方向的明亮、闪烁的星状物体。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. Elsie Dean, her 18-year-old daughter, Cpl. M.D. Emerson (RCMP), Cst. Terry Stilwell (Port Elgin Village Police), and Cst. Anthony.

**Date / Time:** September 18, 1972, at 9:30 PM (initial report) and 10:10 PM (official observation); September 19, 1972, at 1:15 AM; October 3, 1972, at 9:45 PM.

**Location:** Port Elgin and Melrose, Westmorland County, New Brunswick (specifically noted at the intersection of Moore Road and Highway 16).

**Sighting:** On September 18, 1972, at 9:30 PM, Mrs. Elsie Dean reported a UFO sighting. At 10:10 PM, Cpl. M.D. Emerson and Cst. Terry Stilwell observed the object over Port Elgin. The object remained stationary in a cloudy sky for approximately one hour before departing in a westerly direction. Mrs. Dean’s 18-year-old daughter was also present as a witness. 

On September 19, 1972, at 1:15 AM, Cpl. Emerson observed the object again while on patrol toward Cape Tormentine, NB; he noted that the object departed in the direction of Prince Edward Island. Mrs. Dean reported seeing the object a second time on October 3, 1972, at 9:45 PM.

**Object:** The object was described as a very bright, whitish star-like light. It exhibited a pulsating white light, with a bright red flashing light appearing on top at times. It was observed at a high altitude and remained stationary for the duration of the one-hour sighting on September 18 before moving westward.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** Official follow-up included the issuance of Radiogram No. 74. Cpl. Emerson formally noted that the witnesses involved were considered reliable. Authorities conducted inquiries with several military and aviation facilities to identify the object, including checks with CFB Summerside, CFB Chatham, and the radio tower at the Moncton, New Brunswick airport; all checks yielded negative results. On October 3, 1972, Cst. Anthony attempted to locate the object following Mrs. Dean’s second report but was unable to do so.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 埃尔西·迪恩夫人（Mrs. Elsie Dean）、她18岁的女儿、加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）下士 M.D. 埃默森（Cpl. M.D. Emerson）、埃尔金港村警察局警官特里·斯蒂尔韦尔（Cst. Terry Stilwell）以及安东尼警官（Cst. Anthony）。

**日期/时间：** 1972年9月18日晚上9:30（初步报告）及晚上10:10（官方观测）；1972年9月19日凌晨1:15；1972年10月3日晚上9:45。

**地点：** 新不伦瑞克省威斯特摩兰县的埃尔金港（Port Elgin）和梅尔罗斯（Melrose）（具体位置记录在摩尔路与16号公路的交叉路口）。

**目击经过：** 1972年9月18日晚上9:30，埃尔西·迪恩夫人报告了UFO目击事件。晚上10:10，M.D. 埃默森下士和特里·斯蒂尔韦尔警官在埃尔金港上空观测到了该物体。该物体在多云的天空中保持静止约一小时，随后向西飞离。迪恩夫人18岁的女儿当时也在场作为目击者。

1972年9月19日凌晨1:15，埃默森下士在前往新不伦瑞克省托门廷角（Cape Tormentine）的巡逻途中再次观测到了该物体；他指出该物体向爱德华王子岛方向飞去。迪恩夫人于1972年10月3日晚上9:45第二次报告看到了该物体。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一颗非常明亮的、类似白色恒星的光点。它发出脉冲式的白光，顶部有时会出现明亮的红色闪光。在9月18日长达一小时的目击过程中，该物体被观测到处于高空并保持静止，随后向西移动。

**调查/后续：** 官方后续行动包括发布了第74号无线电报。埃默森下士正式记录称，相关目击者被认为是可靠的。当局向多个军事和航空设施进行了询问以识别该物体，包括萨默赛德加拿大空军基地（CFB Summerside）、查塔姆加拿大空军基地（CFB Chatham）以及新不伦瑞克省蒙克顿机场的无线电塔；所有核查结果均为否定。1972年10月3日，安东尼警官在接到迪恩夫人的第二次报告后试图定位该物体，但未能成功。

**Witnesses:** Mr. R. Davis and three other individuals.

**Sighting:** On September 21, 1972, at 0200 Z, a large, round object was observed in the zenith for a duration of two hours. The object remained stationary for a period before moving right to left, up, and down.
