CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p129.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** An Edmonton ID office called in a report, and the log notes that Vancouver AMIS had no information on flights or drones in the area or at that flight level. The entry also mentions a pilot, but says there was no description of the UFO from the pilot at that time. The log is presented as an event record with several time-stamped entries through the day.

**Sighting:** At 1911z, CADS received a UFO report. The log says the call came at 1850z from Edmonton ID, reporting a UFO sighting from QTR739 at FL370 near position 5423N/11958W. Other entries on the page are operational notes such as DSEL going down to paper log, DSEL back up, and the end of the zulu day.

**Object:** The object is described only as a UFO. No shape, color, speed, or behavior is given on this page, and the log explicitly says there was no further description from the pilot at that time.

**Aftermath:** The page shows the report being recorded by CADS and mentions checks with Vancouver AMIS, but it does not include any resolution or identification of the object. The page is marked for release under ATIA and shows classification and log-system text from 2004 NORAD - USNORTHCOM.
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p129.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 记录中提到埃德蒙顿的 ID 办公室进行了通报，温哥华 AMIS 被提及为对该区域或该飞行高度没有航班或无人机信息。页面还提到一名飞行员，但说明当时飞行员没有提供对 UFO 的进一步描述。整页呈现为带有多个时间戳的事件日志。

**目击：** 在 1911z，CADS 收到一则 UFO 报告。日志写明，这通电话是在 1850z 从埃德蒙顿 ID 打来的，报告称 QTR739 在 FL370、位置 5423N/11958W 附近看见 UFO。页面上的其他条目只是运行记录，例如 DSEL 进入纸质日志、DSEL 恢复运行，以及 Zulu 日结束。

**物体：** 物体仅被描述为 UFO。页面没有给出形状、颜色、速度或行为，而且日志明确写到当时飞行员没有提供进一步描述。

**后续：** 页面显示该报告已被 CADS 记录，并提到对温哥华 AMIS 进行了核查，但没有给出对该物体的结论或身份识别。页面标注为根据 ATIA 公开，并显示 2004 NORAD - USNORTHCOM 的分类和日志系统文字。
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p129.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p130.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** A pilot.

**Sighting:** At 0317z, Winnipeg ACC reported that a pilot saw an object descending through the atmosphere before exploding and hitting the ground. The incident occurred at 0230z while the pilot was at FL 220. The coordinates were 52 30N 09507W.

**Object:** An object described as descending through the atmosphere, exploding, and hitting the ground.

**Aftermath:** Trenton JRCC was notified at 0316z. At 0344z, JRCC contacted the CADS MCC and stated that, according to the pilot's account, the object was assessed as a meteor. All ACCs in the area were contacted and all aircraft were accounted for. The impact area was in a remote region and the Ministry of Natural Resources was notified. JRCC continued to monitor the situation.
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p130.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 一名飞行员。

**目击：** 0317z时，温尼伯航空管制中心（Winnipeg ACC）报告称，一名飞行员目击到一个物体穿过大气层，随后发生爆炸并撞击地面。该事件发生在0230z，当时飞行员位于FL 220高度。坐标为北纬52度30分，西经95度07分。

**物体：** 一个穿过大气层、爆炸并撞击地面的物体。

**后续：** 特伦顿联合救援协调中心（Trenton JRCC）于0316z收到通知。0344z时，JRCC联系了加拿大防空部门任务指挥中心（CADS MCC），并表示根据飞行员的描述，该物体被评估为一颗流星。该地区的所有航空管制中心均已联系，所有飞机均已确认安全。撞击区域位于偏远地区，自然资源部已收到通知。JRCC将继续监测情况。
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p130.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p136.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** The pilot of flight AAL 107.

**Sighting:** At 2336Z, CADS requested that AAL 107 turn 90 degrees right to separate its data trail from other aircraft. A single radar hit was detected behind the aircraft at an altitude of 38,200 feet. This hit was passed to Moncton center. After approximately 15 miles, AAL 107 turned back onto its flight plan heading and reported seeing an aircraft with a rotating white light on his left side and behind him.

**Object:** An aircraft with a rotating white light.

**Aftermath:** CADS did not have any radar contact on the trailing aircraft. The incident was logged in the 2004 NORAD-USNORTHCOM event log.
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p136.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** AAL 107 航班飞行员。

**目击：** 在 2336Z 时，CADS 要求 AAL 107 向右转 90 度以将其数据轨迹与其他飞机分离。在 38,200 英尺高度的飞机后方探测到一个单一雷达回波。该信息被传达给蒙克顿中心。在大约 15 英里后，AAL 107 转回原飞行航线，并报告在其左侧后方看到一架带有旋转白光的飞机。

**物体：** 一架带有旋转白光的飞机。

**后续：** CADS 未能在雷达上探测到该尾随飞机。此事件被记录在 2004 年 NORAD-USNORTHCOM 事件日志中。
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p136.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p137.report_summary_zh:

CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p143.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** An individual located on the east side of Digby Island (CYPR).

**Sighting:** At 23:40z on Sunday, September 3, 2017, an individual reported seeing an object moving from west to east. The object was moving fast enough to make a sound.

**Object:** The object was described as black, oblong-shaped, and approximately the size of a volleyball.

**Aftermath:** The Duty Officer was contacted. It was decided that the object did not present a threat to security or aviation. A CIRVIS report was faxed to AARQC.
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p143.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 位于迪格比岛（CYPR）东侧的一名个人。

**目击：** 2017年9月3日星期日23:40z，一名个人报告看到一个物体从西向东移动。该物体移动速度极快，并发出声音。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为黑色、长方形，大小约为排球。

CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p143.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p148.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** The report was initiated by an unnamed individual whose identity is redacted. This person contacted the Edmonton Area Control Centre (ACC) to describe an event from the previous evening.

**Sighting:** The sighting occurred at 7:15 PM local time in High Prarie, Alberta. The witness reported seeing three red lights in the sky.

**Object:** The lights were observed hovering at an altitude comparable to a cell phone tower. The witness noted that the center light was blinking, while the two lights on either side were solid red. After a short period of observation, the objects departed toward the west and were not seen again.

**Aftermath:** The incident was categorized as a CIRVIS (Communications Instructions for Reporting Vital Intelligence Sightings) report. It was entered into a classified NORAD - USNORTHCOM event log at 2218Z. The log for that 'Zulu day' was closed at 2359Z by an individual with the initials 'TB'.
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p148.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 该报告由一名姓名被涂黑的匿名人士发起。该人联系了埃德蒙顿区域管制中心 (ACC)，描述了前一天晚上发生的一起事件。

**目击：** 目击事件发生在当地时间晚上 7:15，地点位于艾伯塔省的高草原 (High Prarie)。见证者报告称在天空中看到了三盏红灯。

**物体：** 观察到这些灯光悬停在与手机信号塔高度相当的高度。见证者注意到中间的灯在闪烁，而两侧的两盏灯则是常亮的红灯。经过短时间的观察后，这些物体向西飞走，再也没有出现。

**后续：** 该事件被归类为 CIRVIS（报告重要情报目击的通信指示）报告。它于 2218Z 被录入机密的 NORAD - USNORTHCOM 事件日志中。该“祖鲁日”的日志于 2359Z 由缩写为“TB”的人员关闭。
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p148.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p149.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Two different sources reported to JRCC Halifax.

**Sighting:** The page says that at 0311z, a phone call was received from JRCC Halifax stating that two different sources reported seeing lights in the sky at 43N-6632W between 0045z and 0130z.

**Object:** Lights in the sky.

**Aftermath:** At 0400z, JRCC Halifax determined that the reported lights were not a Search and Rescue (SAR) related issue and that they found no evidence of anyone in danger. Consequently, they are not continuing to investigate the report.
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p149.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 两个不同的消息来源向哈利法克斯联合救援协调中心（JRCC）报告。

**目击：** 该页面称，在0311z时，接到哈利法克斯JRCC的电话，称有两个不同的消息来源报告在0045z至0130z之间，在43N-6632W位置看到天空中有光。

**物体：** 天空中的光。

**后续：** 在0400z时，哈利法克斯JRCC确定所报告的光并非搜救（SAR）相关问题，且未发现任何人员处于危险之中的证据。因此，他们不再继续调查该报告。
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p149.report_summary_label: Summary (restored from OCR cache, contiguity pass)

CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p151.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** The pilot of a Dash 8 aircraft, flight PVL1910.

**Sighting:** At 0123z, Montreal centre received a CIRVIS report originating from 2300z. The pilot reported observing oscillating vertical red, green, and white lights.

**Object:** Oscillating vertical red, green, and white lights.

**Aftermath:** There was no aircraft within 50 nautical miles ahead of the reporting aircraft. No further information was provided, and the CIRVIS report was sent at 0401z.
CA-FOIA-CIRVIS--Canada-2010-2019-p151.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Dash 8 飞机（航班号 PVL1910）的飞行员。

**目击：** 在 0123z，蒙特利尔中心收到了一份源自 2300z 的 CIRVIS 报告。飞行员报告观察到振荡的垂直红色、绿色和白色灯光。

**物体：** 振荡的垂直红色、绿色和白色灯光。

**后续：** 在报告飞机的前方 50 海里范围内没有其他飞机。未提供更多信息，CIRVIS 报告已于 0401z 发出。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_27_-_Pages_78.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Three individuals, including residents of Lulu Ave and Boyd Ave in Winnipeg, Manitoba.

**Sighting:** On September 19, 1971, between 3:30 AM and 4:00 AM, three witnesses observed an object while in a parked and moving vehicle on a highway approximately 75-100 yards to 1/4 mile from the object, located 10-40 miles north-northwest of Winnipeg. The sky was clear.

**Object:** The object was described as oval in shape, dark in color, and appearing as an outline. It was observed at an altitude of 30-40 feet. The object was seen stationary, spinning, and moving in straight lines. The duration of the sighting was approximately 45 minutes.

**Aftermath:** The witnesses reported that the object followed them along the highway for approximately 40 miles. There were discrepancies between the witnesses regarding the object's shape, size, distance, color, and the length of the sighting, though some points in their stories were coherent. The report notes that sightings were sent to local police, but no confirmation was received. A further report was expected to follow.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_27_-_Pages_78.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 三名个人，包括温尼伯Lulu大道和Boyd大道的居民。

**目击：** 1971年9月19日凌晨3:30至4:00之间，三名见证者在车辆中（包括停放和行驶状态）观察到一个物体。该物体位于温尼伯西北方向10-40英里处，距离见证者约75-100码至1/4英里。当时天空晴朗。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为椭圆形，颜色较暗，呈现轮廓状。观测高度为30-40英尺。物体被观察到处于静止、旋转以及沿直线移动的状态。目击持续时间约为45分钟。

**后续：** 见证者报告称该物体在高速公路上跟随了他们约40英里。三名见证者在描述物体的形状、大小、距离、颜色及目击时长方面存在差异，但他们的叙述在某些点上保持一致。报告指出，目击事件已上报给当地警方，但未收到确认信息。后续将有进一步报告。

001_1948-11-01_Fort McAndrew, Newfoundla.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Two GCA operators at Fort McAndrew, Newfoundland.

**Sighting:** On 1 Nov 1948 at 2145Z, a target was picked up on the GCA scope 3-3/4 miles from the station on a bearing of 123°, then tracked on a heading of about 249° before disappearing at 7-1/2 miles on a bearing of 182°.

**Object:** The blip was judged too small to be an aircraft and too large to be a bird; no shape, color, sound, or other physical features were identified. It appeared to travel at about 60 mph.

**Aftermath:** The target was witnessed by both GCA operators and the incident was summarized as unidentified.
001_1948-11-01_Fort McAndrew, Newfoundla.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 位于纽芬兰 Fort McAndrew 的 2 名 GCA 操作员。

**目击：** 1948年11月1日 2145Z，一个目标在 GCA 屏幕上被捕获，起初位于距站 3又3/4 英里、方位 123° 处；随后按约 249° 航向移动，并在距站 7又1/2 英里、方位 182° 处消失。

**物体：** 该回波被判断为“比鸟大、比飞机小”；未能确定形状、颜色、声音或其他物理特征。其速度估计约为每小时 60 英里。

**后续：** 两名 GCA 操作员都看到了该目标，事件最终仍列为未识别。

001_1947-07-10_Codroy, Newfoundland and.report_summary: Twelve-year-old Albert Samme of Cordroy, Newfoundland reported seeing a single object while alone. He described it as a brightly lit, bright reddish-yellow disc-like object flying at about airplane height at high altitude and moving at terrific speed, visible for only about a minute. His mother, Mrs. Samme, the town postmistress, said the boy’s description matched a ‘flying disc’ and noted he did not think it was a plane.
001_1947-07-10_Codroy, Newfoundland and.report_summary_zh: 12岁的阿尔伯特·萨姆（Albert Samme）在纽芬兰的Cordroy独自一人时看到一个物体。他形容它像一枚亮度很高、呈鲜红偏黄的盘状物，飞行高度大致像飞机、速度极快，只看见约一分钟。他的母亲萨姆夫人（Mrs. Samme，镇邮局女局长）表示，儿子的描述符合“飞碟”的特征，并认为那不可能是飞机。

001_1947-08-04_North Atlantic — Gander N.report_summary: Pages 1–4 are one Powell case: an Air Defense Command summary of Powell’s 4 Aug 1947 sighting and White’s corroborating interview, plus agent notes/evaluation. Page 5 is not part of the sighting; it is a separate Fourteenth Air Force memo from Birmingham, Alabama about a local “flying disc,” likely misfiled/OCR-associated to this FBI serial but unrelated to Powell.
001_1947-08-04_North Atlantic — Gander N.report_summary_zh: 第1–4页属于同一个鲍威尔案件：空防司令部对1947年8月4日目击事件的摘要，以及对白特的访谈和特工评估。第5页不是该目击事件的一部分；它是另一份来自阿拉巴马州伯明翰、第十四空军的备忘录，内容关于当地“飞碟”，很可能是在档案/识别时被并入，但与鲍威尔无关。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_20_-_Pages_57.report_summary: A Barrie man reported seeing a very bright, star-like object and a second accompanying light from his window around 1:20 a.m. on 9 Oct 1951. He described the object as changing shape, showing green lights, and seeming to expand/contract while moving and hovering for roughly two hours. His wife also witnessed it and was willing to sign an affidavit.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_20_-_Pages_57.report_summary_zh: 巴里（安大略省）一名男子报告称，他在1951年10月9日凌晨约1:20从窗边看到一个非常明亮、类似星光的物体，以及另一束伴随的光。该物体会变形、出现绿色灯光，并在移动与悬停中伸缩变化，持续约两小时。他的妻子也目击了这一现象，并愿意提供宣誓书。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_21_-_Pages_60.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. [redacted] of Pouce Coupe, BC.

**Sighting:** On February 21, 1965, at 0311Z, a sighting was reported in Pouce Coupe, British Columbia. The sky was 8/10 cloudy. The object was sighted overhead, traveling in a northerly direction in the area of the Big Dipper. The object appeared very high and moved slowly.

**Object:** The object was described as bright and easily distinguishable, bright orange in color, and round in shape, similar to the size of a large star. The duration of the sighting was four to five minutes.

**Aftermath:** The report was transmitted by Station Beaverlodge to CANFORC ED OPS and Dr. J.A. Jacobs at the University of British Columbia. A handwritten note on the document indicates the message was phoned to Dr. Halliday Smith of DRB to look after distribution to the Meteor Centre.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_21_-_Pages_60.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 位于不列颠哥伦比亚省 Pouce Coupe 的一位先生（姓名已涂黑）。

**目击：** 1965年2月21日 0311Z，在不列颠哥伦比亚省 Pouce Coupe 发生了一起目击事件。当时天空有8/10的云层。物体在头顶上方被观测到，正向北移动，位于北斗七星区域。物体看起来非常高，移动缓慢。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为明亮且易于辨认，呈亮橙色，形状为圆形，大小类似于一颗大恒星。目击持续时间为四到五分钟。

**后续：** 该报告由 Beaverlodge 站发送给 CANFORC ED OPS 以及不列颠哥伦比亚大学的 J.A. Jacobs 博士。文件上的手写笔记显示，该消息已通过电话告知国防研究委员会（DRB）的 Halliday Smith 博士，以便分发给流星中心。

**Witnesses:** A Grade 10 student (name redacted) and a friend (also redacted), walking home together.

**Sighting:** Monday 5 April 1965 at about 8:32 p.m., under very clear sky with a quarter moon. Initially thought a single object was a shooting star, moving from southwest toward northeast. Then a relay-like pattern emerged: one object overtook another, stopped or aligned with it, a third moved in a semicircle toward the north. A glowing red light was reported, and the objects seemed much faster than anything the witness had previously seen.

**Aftermath:** Witness wrote to DND Ottawa on 1965-04-05 with an illustrated drawing of the pattern. Canadian Forces Headquarters replied on 1965-04-13 stating that meteorite/shooting-star showers are common and the report had been forwarded to officials who would contact him if more info was needed.

**Source pages:** pp.3-5 of the FOIA release — p.3 = CFHQ reply, p.4 = original 1965-04-05 letter, p.5 = the hand-drawn sky-path sketch.
